hebrew_line: יִקָּו֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם מִתַּ֤חַת הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וְתֵרָאֶ֖ה הַיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה
kjv_line: Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

hebrew_line: וְשָֽׁרְצ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ וּפָר֥וּ וְרָב֖וּ עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
kjv_line: that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

hebrew_line: יַ֤פְתְּ אֱלֹהִים֙ לְיֶ֔פֶת וְיִשְׁכֹּ֖ן
kjv_line: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell

hebrew_line: וְנַֽעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֖נוּ שֵׁ֑ם פֶּן־נָפ֖וּץ עַל־פְּנֵ֥י כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
kjv_line: and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

hebrew_line: וַאֲבָ֣רֶכְךָ֔ וַאֲגַדְּלָ֖ה שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וֶהְיֵ֖ה בְּרָכָֽה׃
kjv_line: and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

hebrew_line: שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מִן־הַמָּק֖וֹם
kjv_line: from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place

hebrew_line: וְהִפְרֵתִ֤י אֹֽתְךָ֙ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְגוֹיִ֑ם וּמְלָכִ֖ים
kjv_line: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings

hebrew_line: וּבֵֽרַכְתִּ֙יהָ֙ וְהָֽיְתָ֣ה לְגוֹיִ֔ם מַלְכֵ֥י עַמִּ֖ים
kjv_line: also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

hebrew_line: הִנֵּ֣ה׀ בֵּרַ֣כְתִּי אֹת֗וֹ וְהִפְרֵיתִ֥י אֹת֛וֹ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֥י אֹת֖וֹ
kjv_line: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply

hebrew_line: יֻקַּֽח־נָ֣א מְעַט־מַ֔יִם וְרַחֲצ֖וּ רַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם
kjv_line: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet,

hebrew_line: וְאֶקְחָ֨ה פַת־לֶ֜חֶם וְסַעֲד֤וּ לִבְּכֶם֙ אַחַ֣ר תַּעֲבֹ֔רוּ
kjv_line: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on:

hebrew_line: לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית אִם־אֶמְצָ֣א שָׁ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
kjv_line: If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.

hebrew_line: לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֔ה אִם־אֶמְצָ֥א שָׁ֖ם שְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
kjv_line: I will not do it, if I find thirty there.

hebrew_line: אַל־נָ֞א יִ֤חַר לַֽאדֹנָי֙ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אַךְ־הַפַּ֔עַם
kjv_line: Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once:

hebrew_line: הִנֶּ֣ה נָּא־אֲדֹנַ֗י ס֣וּרוּ נָ֠א אֶל־בֵּ֨ית עַבְדְּכֶ֤ם וְלִ֙ינוּ֙ וְרַחֲצ֣וּ רַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם
kjv_line: Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet,

hebrew_line: הוֹצִיאֵ֣ם אֵלֵ֔ינוּ וְנֵדְעָ֖ה אֹתָֽם׃
kjv_line: bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

hebrew_line: אוֹצִֽיאָה־נָּ֤א אֶתְהֶן֙ אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ן כַּטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם
kjv_line: let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes:

hebrew_line: וְאַֽל־תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בְּכָל־הַכִּכָּ֑ר הָהָ֥רָה הִמָּלֵ֖ט
kjv_line: neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain,

hebrew_line: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִשָּׁ֨בְעָה לִּ֤י בֵֽאלֹהִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה אִם־תִּשְׁקֹ֣ר לִ֔י
kjv_line: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely

hebrew_line: תִּקַּ֖ח מִיָּדִ֑י בַּעֲבוּר֙ תִּֽהְיֶה־לִּ֣י לְעֵדָ֔ה כִּ֥י חָפַ֖רְתִּי אֶת־הַבְּאֵ֥ר הַזֹּֽאת׃
kjv_line: shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

hebrew_line: נֵלְכָ֖ה עַד־כֹּ֑ה וְנִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה וְנָשׁ֥וּבָה אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

hebrew_line: גֵּר־וְתוֹשָׁ֥ב אָנֹכִ֖י עִמָּכֶ֑ם תְּנ֨וּ לִ֤י אֲחֻזַּת־קֶ֙בֶר֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְאֶקְבְּרָ֥ה מֵתִ֖י מִלְּפָנָֽי׃
kjv_line: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

hebrew_line: נָתַ֜תִּי כֶּ֤סֶף הַשָּׂדֶה֙ קַ֣ח מִמֶּ֔נִּי וְאֶקְבְּרָ֥ה אֶת־מֵתִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃
kjv_line: me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

hebrew_line: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־תָּשִׁ֥יב אֶת־בְּנִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃
kjv_line: unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

hebrew_line: הַקְרֵה־נָ֥א לְפָנַ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וַעֲשֵׂה־חֶ֕סֶד עִ֖ם אֲדֹנִ֥י אַבְרָהָֽם׃
kjv_line: I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

hebrew_line: לֹ֣א אֹכַ֔ל עַ֥ד אִם־דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי דְּבָרָ֑י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר
kjv_line: I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said,

hebrew_line: הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֔י וְאֶפְנֶ֥ה עַל־יָמִ֖ין א֥וֹ עַל־שְׂמֹֽאל׃
kjv_line: me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

hebrew_line: וַֽיהוָ֖ה הִצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכִּ֑י שַׁלְּח֕וּנִי וְאֵלְכָ֖ה לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃
kjv_line: not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

hebrew_line: גּ֚וּר בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וְאֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמְּךָ֖ וַאֲבָרְכֶ֑ךָּ
kjv_line: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּירָא֙ כִּֽי־אִתְּךָ֣ אָנֹ֔כִי וּבֵֽרַכְתִּ֙יךָ֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֔
kjv_line: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed

hebrew_line: וְצֵא֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְצ֥וּדָה לִּ֖י צָֽיִד׃
kjv_line: and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

hebrew_line: הָבִ֨יאָה לִּ֥י צַ֛יִד וַעֲשֵׂה־לִ֥י מַטְעַמִּ֖ים וְאֹכֵ֑לָה
kjv_line: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat,

hebrew_line: וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ לְאָבִ֖יךָ וְאָכָ֑ל
kjv_line: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat,

hebrew_line: אֵלָ֑י קֽוּם־נָ֣א שְׁבָ֗ה וְאָכְלָה֙ מִצֵּידִ֔י בַּעֲב֖וּר תְּבָרֲכַ֥נִּי נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
kjv_line: me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

hebrew_line: גְּשָׁה־נָּ֥א וַאֲמֻֽשְׁךָ֖ בְּנִ֑י הַֽאַתָּ֥ה זֶ֛ה בְּנִ֥י עֵשָׂ֖ו אִם־לֹֽא׃
kjv_line: Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

hebrew_line: הַגִּ֤שָׁה לִּי֙ וְאֹֽכְלָה֙ מִצֵּ֣יד בְּנִ֔י לְמַ֥עַן תְּבָֽרֶכְךָ֖
kjv_line: Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, may bless thee.

hebrew_line: יַֽעַבְד֣וּךָ עַמִּ֗ים וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֤וּ לְךָ֙ לְאֻמִּ֔ים
kjv_line: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down

hebrew_line: הֱוֵ֤ה גְבִיר֙ לְאַחֶ֔יךָ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲוּ֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּנֵ֣י אִמֶּ֑ךָ
kjv_line: to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down

hebrew_line: יָקֻ֤ם אָבִי֙ וְיֹאכַל֙ מִצֵּ֣יד בְּנ֔וֹ
kjv_line: Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison,

hebrew_line: וָאֹכַ֥ל מִכֹּ֛ל בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא
kjv_line: it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest,

hebrew_line: וְעַל־חַרְבְּךָ֣ תִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְאֶת־אָחִ֖יךָ תַּעֲבֹ֑ד
kjv_line: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother;

hebrew_line: בְּלִבּ֗וֹ יִקְרְבוּ֙ יְמֵי֙ אֵ֣בֶל אָבִ֔י וְאַֽהַרְגָ֖ה אֶת־יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽי׃
kjv_line: in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

hebrew_line: וּלְקַחְתִּ֣יךָ מִשָּׁ֑ם לָמָ֥ה אֶשְׁכַּ֛ל גַּם־שְׁנֵיכֶ֖ם י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
kjv_line: and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

hebrew_line: וְאֵ֤ל שַׁדַּי֙ יְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֹֽתְךָ֔ וְיַפְרְךָ֖ וְיַרְבֶּ֑ךָ
kjv_line: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֤ה זַרְעֲךָ֙ כַּעֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ וּפָרַצְתָּ֛ יָ֥מָּה וָקֵ֖דְמָה
kjv_line: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east,

hebrew_line: וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְשָׁל֖וֹם אֶל־בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י וְהָיָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
kjv_line: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:

hebrew_line: הִנֵּ֛ה אֲמָתִ֥י בִלְהָ֖ה בֹּ֣א אֵלֶ֑יהָ וְתֵלֵד֙ עַל־בִּרְכַּ֔י
kjv_line: Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees,

hebrew_line: שַׁלְּחֵ֙נִי֙ וְאֵ֣לְכָ֔ה אֶל־מְקוֹמִ֖י וּלְאַרְצִֽי׃
kjv_line: Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

hebrew_line: לֹא־תִתֶּן־לִ֣י מְא֔וּמָה אִם־תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לִּי֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה
kjv_line: Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing

hebrew_line: שָׂא־נָ֨א עֵינֶ֤יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ כָּל־הָֽעַתֻּדִים֙ הָעֹלִ֣ים עַל־הַצֹּ֔אן עֲקֻדִּ֥ים נְקֻדִּ֖ים
kjv_line: Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled,

hebrew_line: אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֥רְתָּ לִּ֛י שָׁ֖ם נֶ֑דֶר
kjv_line: and where thou vowedst a vow

hebrew_line: הִשָּׁ֧מֶר לְךָ֛ פֶּן־תְּדַבֵּ֥ר עִֽם־יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִטּ֥וֹב עַד־רָֽע׃
kjv_line: unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

hebrew_line: וְהִכָּ֑הוּ וְהָיָ֛ה הַמַּחֲנֶ֥ה הַנִּשְׁאָ֖ר לִפְלֵיטָֽה׃
kjv_line: and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

hebrew_line: הֵיטֵ֥ב אֵיטִ֖יב עִמָּ֑ךְ וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵרֹֽב׃
kjv_line: I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

hebrew_line: עִבְר֣וּ לְפָנַ֔י וְרֶ֣וַח תָּשִׂ֔ימוּ בֵּ֥ין עֵ֖דֶר
kjv_line: Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove

hebrew_line: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן֙ אֶרְאֶ֣ה פָנָ֔יו אוּלַ֖י יִשָּׂ֥א פָנָֽי׃
kjv_line: and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

hebrew_line: עָל֣וֹת עָלָ֑י וּדְפָקוּם֙ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וָמֵ֖תוּ כָּל־הַצֹּֽאן׃
kjv_line: with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

hebrew_line: בְּנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ תִּתְּנוּ־לָ֔נוּ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ תִּקְח֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

hebrew_line: וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם שְׁבוּ֙ וּסְחָר֔וּהָ
kjv_line: with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade

hebrew_line: הַרְבּ֨וּ עָלַ֤י מְאֹד֙ מֹ֣הַר וּמַתָּ֔ן וְאֶ֨תְּנָ֔ה
kjv_line: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give

hebrew_line: נִֽקַּֽח־לָ֑נוּ וְיָשַׁ֣בְנוּ אִתְּכֶ֔ם
kjv_line: unto you, and we will take to us, and we will dwell

hebrew_line: הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים הָאֵ֜לֶּה שְֽׁלֵמִ֧ים הֵ֣ם אִתָּ֗נוּ וְיֵשְׁב֤וּ בָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וְיִסְחֲר֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ
kjv_line: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade

hebrew_line: הֲמָלֹ֤ךְ תִּמְלֹךְ֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ אִם־מָשׁ֥וֹל תִּמְשֹׁ֖ל
kjv_line: to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us?

hebrew_line: לֶךְ־נָ֨א רְאֵ֜ה אֶת־שְׁל֤וֹם אַחֶ֙יךָ֙ וְאֶת־שְׁל֣וֹם הַצֹּ֔אן
kjv_line: to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks;

hebrew_line: שְׁבִ֧י אַלְמָנָ֣ה בֵית־אָבִ֗יךְ עַד־יִגְדַּל֙ שֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֔י
kjv_line: Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown:

hebrew_line: הָֽבָה־נָּא֙ אָב֣וֹא אֵלַ֔יִךְ כִּ֚י לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כַלָּת֖וֹ הִ֑וא
kjv_line: Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.

hebrew_line: הוֹצִיא֖וּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
kjv_line: Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

hebrew_line: וַהֲשִֽׁיבְךָ֖ עַל־כַּנֶּ֑ךָ וְנָתַתָּ֤ כוֹס־פַּרְעֹה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ
kjv_line: and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand,

hebrew_line: וְעָשִֽׂיתָ־נָּ֥א עִמָּדִ֖י חָ֑סֶד וְהִזְכַּרְתַּ֙נִי֙ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֔ה
kjv_line: with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh,

hebrew_line: בְּזֹ֖את תִּבָּחֵ֑נוּ חֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ אִם־תֵּצְא֣וּ מִזֶּ֔ה
kjv_line: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth

hebrew_line: שִׁלְח֨וּ מִכֶּ֣ם אֶחָד֮ וְיִקַּ֣ח אֶת־אֲחִיכֶם֒ וְאַתֶּם֙ הֵאָ֣סְר֔וּ
kjv_line: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison,

hebrew_line: יֵאָסֵ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית מִשְׁמַרְכֶ֑ם וְאַתֶּם֙ לְכ֣וּ הָבִ֔יאוּ שֶׁ֖בֶר רַעֲב֥וֹן בָּתֵּיכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

hebrew_line: וְאֶת־אֲחִיכֶ֤ם הַקָּטֹן֙ תָּבִ֣יאוּ אֵלַ֔י וְיֵאָמְנ֥וּ דִבְרֵיכֶ֖ם
kjv_line: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified,

hebrew_line: וְלֹ֣א תָמ֑וּתוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵֽן׃
kjv_line: and ye shall not die. And they did so.

hebrew_line: שִׁלְחָ֥ה הַנַּ֛עַר אִתִּ֖י וְנָק֣וּמָה וְנֵלֵ֑כָה
kjv_line: Send the lad with me, and we will arise

hebrew_line: כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יוּכְל֖וּן שְׂאֵ֑ת וְשִׂ֥ים כֶּֽסֶף־אִ֖ישׁ בְּפִ֥י אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.

hebrew_line: אַחֲרֵ֣י הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְהִשַּׂגְתָּם֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לָ֛מָּה שִׁלַּמְתֶּ֥ם רָעָ֖ה
kjv_line: after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil

hebrew_line: הוֹרִדֻ֖הוּ אֵלָ֑י וְאָשִׂ֥ימָה עֵינִ֖י עָלָֽיו׃
kjv_line: Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

hebrew_line: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֧ם גַּם־אֶת־זֶ֛ה מֵעִ֥ם פָּנַ֖י וְקָרָ֣הוּ אָס֑וֹן
kjv_line: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him,

hebrew_line: שָׂמַ֧נִי אֱלֹהִ֛ים לְאָד֖וֹן לְכָל־מִצְרָ֑יִם רְדָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י אַֽל־תַּעֲמֹֽד׃
kjv_line: God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

hebrew_line: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֣ בְאֶֽרֶץ־גֹּ֗שֶׁן וְהָיִ֤יתָ קָרוֹב֙ אֵלַ֔י אַתָּ֕ה
kjv_line: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near

hebrew_line: וּבֹ֣אוּ אֵלָ֑י וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה לָכֶ֗ם אֶת־טוּב֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם
kjv_line: and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt,

hebrew_line: וּנְשָׂאתֶ֥ם אֶת־אֲבִיכֶ֖ם וּבָאתֶֽם׃
kjv_line: and bring your father, and come.

hebrew_line: וְתֶן־זֶ֗רַע וְנִֽחְיֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א נָמ֔וּת
kjv_line: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die,

hebrew_line: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ עִמָּדִי֙ חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֔ת אַל־נָ֥א תִקְבְּרֵ֖נִי בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
kjv_line: and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

hebrew_line: וְשָֽׁכַבְתִּי֙ עִם־אֲבֹתַ֔י וּנְשָׂאתַ֙נִי֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם
kjv_line: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt,

hebrew_line: וּקְבַרְתַּ֖נִי בִּקְבֻרָתָ֑ם וַיֹּאמַ֕ר
kjv_line: and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said,

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵשִׁ֣יב אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

hebrew_line: מֵאֵ֨ל אָבִ֜יךָ וְיַעְזְרֶ֗ךָּ וְאֵ֤ת שַׁדַּי֙ וִיבָ֣רְכֶ֔ךָּ
kjv_line: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless

hebrew_line: יֹ֣אכַל עַ֑ד וְלָעֶ֖רֶב יְחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃
kjv_line: he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

hebrew_line: וֵֽאלֹהִ֞ים פָּקֹ֧ד יִפְקֹ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֗ם וְהֶעֱלָ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את
kjv_line: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land

hebrew_line: וְנִלְחַם־בָּ֖נוּ וְעָלָ֥ה מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
kjv_line: and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.

hebrew_line: הֵילִ֜יכִי אֶת־הַיֶּ֤לֶד הַזֶּה֙ וְהֵינִקִ֣הוּ לִ֔י
kjv_line: unto her, Take this child away, and nurse

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּקְרַ֣ב הֲלֹ֑ם שַׁל־נְעָלֶ֙יךָ֙ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֔יךָ
kjv_line: Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet,

hebrew_line: וּבָאתָ֡ אַתָּה֩ וְזִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֗יִם וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽעִבְרִיִּים֙ נִקְרָ֣ה עָלֵ֔ינוּ
kjv_line: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met

hebrew_line: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֤י אֶת־יָדִי֙ וְהִכֵּיתִ֣י אֶת־מִצְרַ֔יִם
kjv_line: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite

hebrew_line: וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמְע֖וּ בְּקֹלִ֑י כִּ֣י יֹֽאמְר֔וּ
kjv_line: me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say,

hebrew_line: וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֔יו וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים בְּפִ֑יו
kjv_line: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth:

hebrew_line: תַּפְרִ֥יעוּ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם מִמַּֽעֲשָׂ֑יו לְכ֖וּ לְסִבְלֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.

hebrew_line: תִּכְבַּ֧ד הָעֲבֹדָ֛ה עַל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וְיַעֲשׂוּ־בָ֑הּ
kjv_line: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour

hebrew_line: אַתֶּ֗ם לְכ֨וּ קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ תֶּ֔בֶן מֵאֲשֶׁ֖ר
kjv_line: Go ye, get you straw where

hebrew_line: וְלָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֥ם לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים
kjv_line: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God:

hebrew_line: וְיָסֵר֙ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֔ים מִמֶּ֖נִּי וּמֵֽעַמִּ֑י וַאֲשַׁלְּחָה֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם
kjv_line: that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go,

hebrew_line: הַשְׁכֵּ֤ם בַּבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וְהִתְיַצֵּב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה
kjv_line: Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh;

hebrew_line: שַׁלַּ֥ח עַמִּ֖י וְיַֽעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Let my people go, that they may serve me.

hebrew_line: הֵ֣ן נִזְבַּ֞ח אֶת־תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת מִצְרַ֛יִם לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א יִסְקְלֻֽנוּ׃
kjv_line: for lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

hebrew_line: פַּרְעֹ֗ה אָנֹכִ֞י אֲשַׁלַּ֤ח אֶתְכֶם֙ וּזְבַחְתֶּ֞ם לַיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר
kjv_line: And Pharaoh I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness;

hebrew_line: וְיָרַ֧ד עֲלֵהֶ֛ם הַבָּרָ֖ד וָמֵֽתוּ׃
kjv_line: the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.

hebrew_line: הַקֹּל֣וֹת יֶחְדָּל֗וּן וְהַבָּרָד֙ לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה־ע֔וֹד לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֔ע
kjv_line: and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know

hebrew_line: מִפָּנָ֑י שַׁלַּ֥ח עַמִּ֖י וְיַֽעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
kjv_line: thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.

hebrew_line: לֹ֣א כֵ֗ן לְכֽוּ־נָ֤א הַגְּבָרִים֙ וְעִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אֹתָ֖הּ
kjv_line: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the LORD;

hebrew_line: וְגַם־מִקְנֵ֜נוּ יֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֗נוּ לֹ֤א תִשָּׁאֵר֙ פַּרְסָ֔ה
kjv_line: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind;

hebrew_line: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ אֶל־תֹּ֙סֶף֙ רְא֣וֹת פָּנַ֔י כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם רְאֹתְךָ֥ פָנַ֖י תָּמֽוּת׃
kjv_line: unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

hebrew_line: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ מִן־הַדָּ֔ם וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ עַל־שְׁתֵּ֥י הַמְּזוּזֹ֖ת
kjv_line: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts

hebrew_line: מִקְרָא־קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־מְלָאכָה֙ לֹא־יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם
kjv_line: there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done

hebrew_line: בְּבַ֤יִת אֶחָד֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹא־תוֹצִ֧יא מִן־הַבַּ֛יִת מִן־הַבָּשָׂ֖ר ח֑וּצָה
kjv_line: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house;

hebrew_line: וְחִזַּקְתִּ֣י אֶת־לֵב־פַּרְעֹה֮ וְרָדַ֣ף אַחֲרֵיהֶם֒ וְאִכָּבְדָ֤ה בְּפַרְעֹה֙
kjv_line: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh,

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּירָאוּ֒ הִֽתְיַצְב֗וּ וּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־יְשׁוּעַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה
kjv_line: Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD,

hebrew_line: וְאַתָּ֞ה הָרֵ֣ם אֶֽת־מַטְּךָ֗ וּנְטֵ֧ה אֶת־יָדְךָ֛ עַל־הַיָּ֖ם
kjv_line: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea,

hebrew_line: וּבְקָעֵ֑הוּ וְיָבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּ֖ם בַּיַּבָּשָֽׁה׃
kjv_line: and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.

hebrew_line: וְיָבֹ֖אוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְאִכָּבְדָ֤ה בְּפַרְעֹה֙
kjv_line: of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh,

hebrew_line: וּבְרֹ֥ב גְּאוֹנְךָ֖ תַּהֲרֹ֣ס קָמֶ֑יךָ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ חֲרֹ֣נְךָ֔
kjv_line: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath,

hebrew_line: תְּבִאֵ֗מוֹ וְתִטָּעֵ֙מוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַחֲלָֽתְךָ֔
kjv_line: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance,

hebrew_line: וְיָצָ֨א הָעָ֤ם וְלָֽקְטוּ֙ דְּבַר־י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֔וֹ
kjv_line: for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day,

hebrew_line: שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים תִּלְקְטֻ֑הוּ וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֛י שַׁבָּ֖ת לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־בּֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

hebrew_line: שְׁב֣וּ׀ אִ֣ישׁ תַּחְתָּ֗יו אַל־יֵ֥צֵא אִ֛ישׁ מִמְּקֹמ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
kjv_line: abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

hebrew_line: וְתֶן־שָׁ֥מָּה מְלֹֽא־הָעֹ֖מֶר מָ֑ן וְהַנַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.

hebrew_line: מַה־תְּרִיבוּן֙ עִמָּדִ֔י מַה־תְּנַסּ֖וּן אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃
kjv_line: unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?

hebrew_line: מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה ע֥וֹד מְעַ֖ט וּסְקָלֻֽנִי׃
kjv_line: What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

hebrew_line: עֲבֹר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם וְקַ֥ח אִתְּךָ֖ מִזִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל

hebrew_line: וְקָם֩ הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה וְזָנָ֣ה׀ אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵֽכַר־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא בָא־שָׁ֙מָּה֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ
kjv_line: and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among

hebrew_line: וְחָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֣י ב֣וֹ בַיּוֹם־הַ֠הוּא וַעֲזַבְתִּ֞ים וְהִסְתַּרְתִּ֨י פָנַ֤י מֵהֶם֙ וְהָיָ֣ה
kjv_line: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face

hebrew_line: וּפָנָ֞ה אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ וַעֲבָד֔וּם
kjv_line: then will they turn unto other gods, and serve

hebrew_line: וְשַׂמְתֶּ֣ם אֹת֔וֹ מִצַּ֛ד אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָֽיָה־שָׁ֥ם בְּךָ֖ לְעֵֽד׃
kjv_line: and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.

hebrew_line: וּבְתֹ֖הוּ יְלֵ֣ל יְשִׁמֹ֑ן יְסֹֽבְבֶ֙נְהוּ֙ יְב֣וֹנְנֵ֔הוּ
kjv_line: and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed

hebrew_line: כְּנֶ֙שֶׁר֙ יָעִ֣יר קִנּ֔וֹ עַל־גּוֹזָלָ֖יו יְרַחֵ֑ף
kjv_line: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young,

hebrew_line: יִפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפָיו֙ יִקָּחֵ֔הוּ
kjv_line: spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh

hebrew_line: אַסְפֶּ֥ה עָלֵ֖ימוֹ רָע֑וֹת חִצַּ֖י אֲכַלֶּה־בָּֽם׃
kjv_line: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

hebrew_line: ל֥וּ חָכְמ֖וּ יַשְׂכִּ֣ילוּ זֹ֑את יָבִ֖ינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃
kjv_line: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

hebrew_line: אֲנִ֧י אָמִ֣ית וַאֲחַיֶּ֗ה מָחַ֙צְתִּי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶרְפָּ֔א
kjv_line: with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal:

hebrew_line: כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיִ֤יתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א אַרְפְּךָ֖
kjv_line: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail

hebrew_line: לֹֽא־יָמ֡וּשׁ סֵפֶר֩ הַתּוֹרָ֨ה הַזֶּ֜ה מִפִּ֗יךָ וְהָגִ֤יתָ בּוֹ֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה
kjv_line: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night,

hebrew_line: וְשַׁבְתֶּ֞ם לְאֶ֤רֶץ יְרֻשַּׁתְכֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אוֹתָ֔הּ
kjv_line: them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy

hebrew_line: רִדְפ֥וּ מַהֵ֛ר אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם כִּ֥י תַשִּׂיגֽוּם׃
kjv_line: not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

hebrew_line: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם גַּם־אַתֶּ֜ם עִם־בֵּ֤ית אָבִי֙ חֶ֔סֶד וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לִ֖י א֥וֹת אֱמֶֽת׃
kjv_line: that ye will also shew kindness unto my father's house, and give me a true token:

hebrew_line: לֵּ֔כוּ פֶּֽן־יִפְגְּע֥וּ בָכֶ֖ם הָרֹדְפִ֑ים
kjv_line: lest the pursuers meet

hebrew_line: גֹּ֣שׁוּ הֵ֔נָּה וְשִׁמְע֕וּ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.

hebrew_line: וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתָם֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהִנַּחְתֶּ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם בַּמָּל֕וֹן אֲשֶׁר־תָּלִ֥ינוּ ב֖וֹ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃
kjv_line: and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.

hebrew_line: וְנָ֨פְלָ֜ה חוֹמַ֤ת הָעִיר֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ וְעָל֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ נֶגְדּֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

hebrew_line: וְרַק־אַתֶּם֙ שִׁמְר֣וּ מִן־הַחֵ֔רֶם פֶּֽן־תַּחֲרִ֖ימוּ
kjv_line: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed,

hebrew_line: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֣ם מִן־הַחֵ֑רֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּ֞ם אֶת־מַחֲנֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְחֵ֔רֶם
kjv_line: when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse,

hebrew_line: וְיַכּ֣וּ אֶת־הָעָ֑י אַל־תְּיַגַּע־שָׁ֙מָּה֙ אֶת־כָּל־הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י מְעַ֖ט הֵֽמָּה׃
kjv_line: and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.

hebrew_line: וְנָסַ֣בּוּ עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְהִכְרִ֥יתוּ אֶת־שְׁמֵ֖נוּ מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ
kjv_line: of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth:

hebrew_line: תָּבֹ֣זּוּ לָכֶ֑ם שִׂים־לְךָ֥ אֹרֵ֛ב לָעִ֖יר מֵאַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃
kjv_line: thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

hebrew_line: אַל־תַּרְחִ֥יקוּ מִן־הָעִ֖יר מְאֹ֑ד וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם נְכֹנִֽים׃
kjv_line: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:

hebrew_line: כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ רְא֖וּ צִוִּ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

hebrew_line: עֲלֽוּ־אֵלַ֣י וְעִזְרֻ֔נִי וְנַכֶּ֖ה אֶת־גִּבְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־הִשְׁלִ֥ימָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וְאֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
kjv_line: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

hebrew_line: עֲלֵ֧ה אֵלֵ֣ינוּ מְהֵרָ֗ה וְהוֹשִׁ֤יעָה לָּ֙נוּ֙ וְעָזְרֵ֔נוּ
kjv_line: come up to us quickly, and save us, and help

hebrew_line: וַיִּדֹּ֨ם הַשֶּׁ֜מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֣חַ עָמָ֗ד עַד־יִקֹּ֥ם גּוֹי֙ אֹֽיְבָ֔יו
kjv_line: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies.

hebrew_line: וְיָצָ֥א מִבֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל ל֑וּזָה
kjv_line: And goeth out from Beth-el to Luz,

hebrew_line: וְנָסַ֧ב הַגְּב֛וּל מִזְרָ֖חָה תַּאֲנַ֣ת שִׁלֹ֑ה
kjv_line: and the border went about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh,

hebrew_line: וּפָגַע֙ בִּֽירִיח֔וֹ וְיָצָ֖א הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
kjv_line: and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

hebrew_line: וְאֶשְׁלָחֵ֗ם וְיָקֻ֜מוּ וְיִֽתְהַלְּכ֥וּ בָאָ֛רֶץ וְיִכְתְּב֥וּ אוֹתָ֛הּ לְפִ֥י נַֽחֲלָתָ֖ם
kjv_line: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance

hebrew_line: וַֽהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י הֵ֑נָּה וְיָרִ֨יתִי לָכֶ֤ם גּוֹרָל֙ פֹּ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
kjv_line: and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

hebrew_line: וְתָאַ֣ר הַגְּבוּל֩ וְנָסַ֨ב לִפְאַת־יָ֜ם נֶ֗גְבָּה מִן־הָהָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י בֵית־חֹרוֹן֮ נֶגְבָּה֒ וְהָי֣וּ תֹֽצְאֹתָ֗יו אֶל־קִרְיַת־בַּ֙עַל֙ הִ֚יא קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים
kjv_line: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim,

hebrew_line: וְתָאַ֣ר מִצָּפ֗וֹן וְיָצָא֙ עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ
kjv_line: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to En-shemesh,

hebrew_line: וְעָבַ֛ר אֶל־כֶּ֥תֶף מוּל־הָֽעֲרָבָ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָה וְיָרַ֖ד הָעֲרָבָֽתָה׃
kjv_line: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

hebrew_line: וְעָבַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־כֶּ֣תֶף בֵּית־חָגְלָה֮ צָפוֹנָה֒ וְהָי֣וּ תֹּצְא֣וֹת הַגְּב֗וּל אֶל־לְשׁ֤וֹן יָם־הַמֶּ֙לַח֙ צָפ֔וֹנָה
kjv_line: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea

hebrew_line: וְנָ֞ס אֶל־אַחַ֣ת׀ מֵהֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְעָמַד֙ פֶּ֚תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֔יר
kjv_line: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city,

hebrew_line: ה֣וּא יֵדָ֑ע אִם־בְּמֶ֤רֶד וְאִם־בְּמַ֙עַל֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה אַל־תּוֹשִׁיעֵ֖נוּ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
kjv_line: he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, save us not this day,

hebrew_line: וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶ֑ם וְחָרָ֤ה אַף־יְהוָה֙ בָּכֶ֔ם
kjv_line: and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled

hebrew_line: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְר֧אוּ אֶת־יְהוָ֛ה וְעִבְד֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּתָמִ֣ים וּבֶֽאֱמֶ֑ת
kjv_line: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth:

hebrew_line: עִמָּ֑נוּ וְהָיְתָ֤ה בָכֶם֙ לְעֵדָ֔ה פֶּֽן־תְּכַחֲשׁ֖וּן בֵּאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

hebrew_line: עֲלֵ֧ה אִתִּ֣י בְגוֹרָלִ֗י וְנִֽלָּחֲמָה֙ בַּֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י
kjv_line: Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites;

hebrew_line: הַרְאֵ֤נוּ נָא֙ אֶת־מְב֣וֹא הָעִ֔יר וְעָשִׂ֥ינוּ עִמְּךָ֖ חָֽסֶד׃
kjv_line: unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ עִם־הַשֹּׁפֵ֔ט וְהֽוֹשִׁיעָם֙ מִיַּ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם
kjv_line: then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies

hebrew_line: הָלֹ֧ךְ אֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֗ךְ אֶ֚פֶס כִּי֩ לֹ֨א תִֽהְיֶ֜ה תִּֽפְאַרְתְּךָ֗ עַל־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּ֣ה הוֹלֵ֔ךְ
kjv_line: I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour;

hebrew_line: וְהִנַּחְתִּ֖י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אָנֹכִ֥י אֵשֵׁ֖ב עַ֥ד שׁוּבֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.

hebrew_line: קַ֣ח אֶת־הַבָּשָׂ֤ר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת֙ וְהַנַּח֙ אֶל־הַסֶּ֣לַע הַלָּ֔ז וְאֶת־הַמָּרַ֖ק
kjv_line: unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, the broth.

hebrew_line: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַפָּ֣ר הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְהַעֲלִ֣יתָ עוֹלָ֔ה בַּעֲצֵ֥י הָאֲשֵׁרָ֖ה
kjv_line: and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove

hebrew_line: אֲשֶׁר־עָמְד֨וּ עָלָ֜יו הַאַתֶּ֣ם׀ תְּרִיב֣וּן לַבַּ֗עַל אִם־אַתֶּם֙ תּוֹשִׁיע֣וּן אוֹת֔וֹ
kjv_line: unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him?

hebrew_line: אַל־יִ֤חַר אַפְּךָ֙ בִּ֔י וַאֲדַבְּרָ֖ה
kjv_line: Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak

hebrew_line: וְשָֽׁמַעְתָּ֙ מַה־יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ וְאַחַר֙ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יָדֶ֔יךָ
kjv_line: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened

hebrew_line: וְלִכְד֤וּ לָהֶם֙ אֶת־הַמַּ֔יִם עַ֛ד בֵּ֥ית בָּרָ֖ה וְאֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן
kjv_line: and take before them the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan.

hebrew_line: ק֤וּם אַתָּה֙ וּפְגַע־בָּ֔נוּ כִּ֥י כָאִ֖ישׁ גְּבוּרָת֑וֹ
kjv_line: Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength.

hebrew_line: תֵּ֤צֵא אֵשׁ֙ מִן־הָ֣אָטָ֔ד וְתֹאכַ֖ל אֶת־אַרְזֵ֥י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
kjv_line: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.

hebrew_line: תֵּ֤צֵא אֵשׁ֙ מֵאֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְתֹאכַ֛ל אֶת־בַּעֲלֵ֥י שְׁכֶ֖ם
kjv_line: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem,

hebrew_line: וּמִ֨י יִתֵּ֜ן אֶת־הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ בְּיָדִ֔י וְאָסִ֖ירָה אֶת־אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ
kjv_line: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech.

hebrew_line: וּמ֣וֹתְתֵ֔נִי פֶּן־יֹ֥אמְרוּ לִ֖י אִשָּׁ֣ה הֲרָגָ֑תְהוּ
kjv_line: and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him.

hebrew_line: וְהָיִ֥יתָה לָּ֖נוּ לְקָצִ֑ין וְנִֽלָּחֲמָ֖ה בִּבְנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
kjv_line: Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

hebrew_line: דִּרְשׁ֤וּ יְהוָה֙ וְעֻזּ֔וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֥וּ פָנָ֖יו תָּמִֽיד׃
kjv_line: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.

hebrew_line: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כָּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־אֶל־י֖וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.

hebrew_line: וּבֹ֣אוּ לְפָנָ֔יו הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
kjv_line: and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

hebrew_line: חִ֤ילוּ מִלְּפָנָיו֙ כָּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אַף־תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּבֵ֖ל בַּל־תִּמּֽוֹט׃
kjv_line: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

hebrew_line: יִשְׂמְח֤וּ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ
kjv_line: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice:

hebrew_line: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠קוֹם לְעַמִּ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּנְטַעְתִּ֙יהוּ֙ וְשָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד
kjv_line: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved

hebrew_line: וָאַגִּ֣ד לָ֔ךְ וּבַ֖יִת יִֽבְנֶה־לְּךָ֥ יְהוָֽה׃
kjv_line: Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

hebrew_line: יִֽהְיֶה־לִּ֣י לְבֵ֑ן וְחַסְדִּי֙ לֹא־אָסִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲסִיר֔וֹתִי
kjv_line: and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took

hebrew_line: אֲנִ֖י נֹטֶ֣ה עָלֶ֑יךָ בְּחַר־לְךָ֛ אַחַ֥ת מֵהֵ֖נָּה וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה־לָּֽךְ׃
kjv_line: I offer things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

hebrew_line: וְאֶבְנֶה־בּ֥וֹ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה בְּכֶ֤סֶף מָלֵא֙ תְּנֵ֣הוּ לִ֔י
kjv_line: that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price:

hebrew_line: וַהֲנִח֥וֹתִי ל֛וֹ מִכָּל־אוֹיְבָ֖יו מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמ֔וֹ
kjv_line: and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon,

hebrew_line: עַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֔י יְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהִצְלַחְתָּ֗
kjv_line: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper

hebrew_line: אַ֣ךְ יִֽתֶּן־לְּךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה וִֽיצַוְּךָ֖ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
kjv_line: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel,

hebrew_line: הֽוּא־יִבְנֶ֥ה בֵיתִ֖י וַחֲצֵרוֹתָ֑י כִּי־בָחַ֨רְתִּי ב֥וֹ לִי֙ לְבֵ֔ן וַאֲנִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶה־לּ֥וֹ לְאָֽב׃
kjv_line: he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

hebrew_line: וְאַתָּ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה־בְנִ֡י דַּע֩ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֨י אָבִ֜יךָ וְעָבְדֵ֗הוּ בְּלֵ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙
kjv_line: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart

hebrew_line: שֳׁמְרָה־זֹּ֣את לְעוֹלָ֔ם לְיֵ֥צֶר מַחְשְׁב֖וֹת לְבַ֣ב עַמֶּ֑ךָ וְהָכֵ֥ן לְבָבָ֖ם
kjv_line: keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

hebrew_line: וְאַתָּ֣ה׀ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ וְשָׁפַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ
kjv_line: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants,

hebrew_line: וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה מָטָ֖ר כִּ֣י יֶֽחֶטְאוּ־לָ֑ךְ
kjv_line: and there is no rain, because they have sinned

hebrew_line: וְהִֽתְפַּלְל֞וּ אֶל־הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ וְהוֹד֣וּ אֶת־שְׁמֶ֔ךָ מֵחַטָּאתָ֥ם יְשׁוּב֖וּן
kjv_line: against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin,

hebrew_line: וְאַתָּ֣ה׀ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְסָ֨לַחְתָּ֜ לְחַטַּ֤את עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
kjv_line: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel,

hebrew_line: וְ֠אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֨ע מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם מְכ֤וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֙ךָ֙ וְסָ֣לַחְתָּ֔
kjv_line: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive,

hebrew_line: וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם וְסָלַחְתָּ֥ לְעַמְּךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָֽטְאוּ־לָֽךְ׃
kjv_line: and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.

hebrew_line: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים אַל־תָּשֵׁ֖ב פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶ֑יךָ זָכְרָ֕ה לְחַֽסְדֵ֖י דָּוִ֥יד עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
kjv_line: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.

hebrew_line: הֵ֣ן אֶֽעֱצֹ֤ר הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר
kjv_line: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain,

hebrew_line: אַשְׁלִ֖יךְ מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י וְאֶתְּנֶ֛נּוּ לְמָשָׁ֥ל
kjv_line: will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb

hebrew_line: וְאַתָּ֖ה הָקֵ֣ל מֵעָלֵ֑ינוּ כֹּ֚ה תֹּאמַ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם קָֽטָנִּ֥י עָבָ֖ה מִמָּתְנֵ֥י אָבִֽי׃
kjv_line: but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

hebrew_line: וְלֹא־תִלָּ֨חֲמ֜וּ עִם־אֲחֵיכֶ֗ם שׁ֚וּבוּ אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֔וֹ
kjv_line: nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house:

hebrew_line: נִבְנֶ֣ה׀ אֶת־הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְנָסֵ֨ב חוֹמָ֣ה
kjv_line: Let us build these cities, and make about them walls,

hebrew_line: הֲתֵלֵ֥ךְ עִמִּ֖י רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד
kjv_line: Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth-gilead?

hebrew_line: הֲנֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל־רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה
kjv_line: unto them, Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle,

hebrew_line: לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲלֵ֞ה רָמֹ֤ת גִּלְעָד֙ וְהַצְלַ֔ח
kjv_line: so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper:

hebrew_line: וִֽיהִי־נָ֧א דְבָרְךָ֛ כְּאַחַ֥ד מֵהֶ֖ם וְדִבַּ֥רְתָּ טּֽוֹב׃
kjv_line: let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.

hebrew_line: מִיכָה֙ הֲנֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל־רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה
kjv_line: unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle,

hebrew_line: הֲפֹ֧ךְ יָדְךָ֛ וְהוֹצֵאתַ֥נִי מִן־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה כִּ֥י הָחֳלֵֽיתִי׃
kjv_line: Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

hebrew_line: וְעַתָּ֕ה יְהִ֥י פַֽחַד־יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם שִׁמְר֣וּ וַעֲשׂ֔וּ
kjv_line: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do

hebrew_line: וְאַל־תֵּחַ֔תּוּ מָחָר֙ צְא֣וּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיהוָ֖ה עִמָּכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֡י בְּעֵת֩ יָבִ֨יא אֶת־הָֽאָר֜וֹן אֶל־פְּקֻדַּ֣ת הַמֶּלֶךְ֮ בְּיַ֣ד הַלְוִיִּם֒
kjv_line: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites,

hebrew_line: וִֽישִׁיבֻ֣הוּ אֶל־מְקֹמ֑וֹ כֹּ֤ה עָשׂוּ֙ לְי֣וֹם׀ בְּי֔וֹם וַיַּֽאַסְפוּ־כֶ֖סֶף לָרֹֽב׃
kjv_line: it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

hebrew_line: חֲדַל־לְךָ֖ לָ֣מָּה יַכּ֑וּךָ
kjv_line: forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten?

hebrew_line: עַתָּ֕ה אַל־תַּקְשׁ֥וּ עָרְפְּכֶ֖ם כַּאֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם תְּנוּ־יָ֣ד לַיהוָ֗ה
kjv_line: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto the LORD,

hebrew_line: וְעִבְדוּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם וְיָשֹׁ֥ב מִכֶּ֖ם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.

hebrew_line: וְלֹא־יָסִ֤יר פָּנִים֙ מִכֶּ֔ם אִם־תָּשׁ֖וּבוּ אֵלָֽיו׃
kjv_line: and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

hebrew_line: מִֽי־בָכֶ֣ם מִכָּל־עַמּ֗וֹ יְהִ֤י אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וְיַ֕עַל
kjv_line: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up

hebrew_line: וַאֲמַר־לֵ֓הּ׀ אֵ֚ל מָֽאנַיָּ֔א שֵׂ֚א אֵֽזֶל־אֲחֵ֣ת הִמּ֔וֹ בְּהֵיכְלָ֖א
kjv_line: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple

hebrew_line: יַהֲתִיב֗וּן וִ֠יהָךְ לְהֵיכְלָ֤א דִי־בִירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ לְאַתְרֵ֔הּ
kjv_line: be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place,

hebrew_line: כָּל־קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָה֩ אָסְפַּ֨רְנָא תִקְנֵ֜א בְּכַסְפָּ֣א דְנָ֗ה תּוֹרִ֤ין׀ דִּכְרִין֙ אִמְּרִ֔ין וּמִנְחָתְה֖וֹן וְנִסְכֵּיה֑וֹן וּתְקָרֵ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ עַֽל־מַדְבְּחָ֔ה
kjv_line: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar

hebrew_line: יָחֳרַ֖ם כָּל־רְכוּשׁ֑וֹ וְה֥וּא יִבָּדֵ֖ל מִקְּהַ֥ל הַגּוֹלָֽה׃
kjv_line: all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

hebrew_line: וְשַׁבְתֶּ֣ם אֵלַ֔י וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֹתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם
kjv_line: But if ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do

hebrew_line: וְהַצְלִֽיחָה־נָּ֤א לְעַבְדְּךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וּתְנֵ֣הוּ לְרַחֲמִ֔ים
kjv_line: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy

hebrew_line: וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֲבָדָ֖יו נָק֣וּם וּבָנִ֑ינוּ
kjv_line: us; therefore we his servants will arise and build:

hebrew_line: וְאֵ֣ת׀ שַׁ֣עַר הָאַשְׁפּ֗וֹת הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן־רֵכָ֔ב שַׂ֖ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית־הַכָּ֑רֶם ה֣וּא יִבְנֶ֔נּוּ וְיַעֲמִיד֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃
kjv_line: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth-haccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

hebrew_line: וְאֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הָעַ֜יִן הֶ֠חֱזִיק שַׁלּ֣וּן בֶּן־כָּל־חֹזֶה֮ שַׂ֣ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ הַמִּצְפָּה֒ ה֤וּא יִבְנֶ֙נּוּ֙ וִיטַֽלְלֶ֔נּוּ
kjv_line: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered

hebrew_line: הֲיַעַזְב֨וּ לָהֶ֤ם הֲיִזְבָּ֙חוּ֙ הַיְכַלּ֣וּ בַיּ֔וֹם הַיְחַיּ֧וּ אֶת־הָאֲבָנִ֛ים מֵעֲרֵמ֥וֹת הֶעָפָ֖ר
kjv_line: will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish

hebrew_line: וְהָשֵׁ֥ב חֶרְפָּתָ֖ם אֶל־רֹאשָׁ֑ם וּתְנֵ֥ם לְבִזָּ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שִׁבְיָֽה׃
kjv_line: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:

hebrew_line: וְאֶל־יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם אַל־תִּֽירְא֖וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם אֶת־אֲדֹנָ֞י הַגָּד֤וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא֙ זְכֹ֔רוּ
kjv_line: and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible,

hebrew_line: נִוָּעֵד֩ אֶל־בֵּ֨ית הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הַֽהֵיכָ֗ל וְנִסְגְּרָה֙ דַּלְת֣וֹת הַהֵיכָ֔ל
kjv_line: Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple:

hebrew_line: וּבְעֵ֤ת צָֽרָתָם֙ יִצְעֲק֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּה֙ מִשָּׁמַ֣יִם תִּשְׁמָ֔ע
kjv_line: who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven;

hebrew_line: וְאַתָּ֞ה מִשָּׁמַ֧יִם תִּשְׁמַ֛ע וְתַצִּילֵ֥ם כְּֽרַחֲמֶ֖יךָ רַבּ֥וֹת עִתִּֽים׃
kjv_line: unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;

hebrew_line: וָאַשְׁבִּיעֵ֣ם בֵּֽאלֹהִ֗ים אִם־תִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ לִבְנֵיהֶ֔ם

hebrew_line: וְהִרְכִּיבֻ֤הוּ עַל־הַסּוּס֙ בִּרְח֣וֹב הָעִ֔יר וְקָרְא֣וּ לְפָנָ֔יו
kjv_line: and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before

hebrew_line: וְ֠אַתֶּם כִּתְב֨וּ עַל־הַיְּהוּדִ֜ים כַּטּ֤וֹב בְּעֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְחִתְמ֖וּ
kjv_line: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king's name, and seal

hebrew_line: רַ֣ק אֵלָ֔יו אַל־תִּשְׁלַ֖ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מֵעִ֖ם פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

hebrew_line: יֹ֣אבַד י֭וֹם אִוָּ֣לֶד בּ֑וֹ

hebrew_line: יִגְאָלֻ֡הוּ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְ֭צַלְמָוֶת תִּשְׁכָּן־עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנָ֑ה

kjv_line: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light,

hebrew_line: יוֹמָ֥ם יְפַגְּשׁוּ־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וְ֝כַלַּ֗יְלָה יְֽמַשְׁשׁ֥וּ בַֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
kjv_line: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

hebrew_line: ל֗וּ שָׁק֣וֹל יִשָּׁקֵ֣ל כַּעְשִׂ֑י וְ֝הַוָּתִ֗י בְּֽמֹאזְנַ֥יִם יִשְׂאוּ־יָֽחַד׃
kjv_line: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!

hebrew_line: מִֽי־יִ֭תֵּן תָּב֣וֹא שֶֽׁאֱלָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י יִתֵּ֥ן אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
kjv_line: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

hebrew_line: וְיֹאֵ֣ל אֱ֭לוֹהַּ וִֽידַכְּאֵ֑נִי

kjv_line: yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare;

hebrew_line: יַעֲל֖וּ בַתֹּ֣הוּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃

hebrew_line: ה֭וֹרוּנִי וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ
kjv_line: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue:

hebrew_line: שֻֽׁבוּ־נָ֭א אַל־תְּהִ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה

hebrew_line: מָתַ֣י אָ֭קוּם וּמִדַּד־עָ֑רֶב

hebrew_line: וְחִתַּתַּ֥נִי בַחֲלֹמ֑וֹת וּֽמֵחֶזְיֹנ֥וֹת תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
kjv_line: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:

hebrew_line: מָ֭אַסְתִּי לֹא־לְעֹלָ֣ם אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה חֲדַ֥ל מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי כִּי־הֶ֥בֶל יָמָֽי׃

hebrew_line: וּמֶ֤ה׀ לֹא־תִשָּׂ֣א פִשְׁעִי֮ וְתַעֲבִ֪יר אֶת־עֲוֹ֫נִ֥י

hebrew_line: יִשָּׁעֵ֣ן עַל־בֵּ֭יתוֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֑ד
kjv_line: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand:

hebrew_line: עַל־גַּ֭ל שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יְסֻבָּ֑כוּ בֵּ֖ית אֲבָנִ֣ים יֶחֱזֶֽה׃

hebrew_line: הֵ֤ן יַעֲבֹ֣ר עָ֭לַי וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶ֑ה
kjv_line: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see

hebrew_line: הֽ֝וֹדִיעֵ֗נִי עַ֣ל מַה־תְּרִיבֵֽנִי׃

hebrew_line: א֤וֹ שִׂ֣יחַ לָאָ֣רֶץ וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ
kjv_line: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach

hebrew_line: הֵ֤ן יַעְצֹ֣ר בַּמַּ֣יִם וְיִבָ֑שׁוּ
kjv_line: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up:

hebrew_line: מִֽי־יִ֭תֵּן הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישׁ֑וּן וּתְהִ֖י לָכֶ֣ם לְחָכְמָֽה׃

hebrew_line: הַחֲרִ֣ישׁוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה־אָ֑נִי

hebrew_line: תִּתְקְפֵ֣הוּ לָ֭נֶצַח וַֽיַּהֲלֹ֑ךְ מְשַׁנֶּ֥ה פָ֝נָ֗יו

hebrew_line: יִכְבְּד֣וּ בָ֭נָיו וְלֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע

hebrew_line: הֵ֤ן אֶצְעַ֣ק חָ֭מָס וְלֹ֣א אֵעָנֶ֑ה

hebrew_line: כַּחֲל֣וֹם יָ֭עוּף וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּהוּ וְ֝יֻדַּ֗ד כְּחֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה׃

kjv_line: Though he spare it, and forsake

hebrew_line: שָׂ֭אוּנִי וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר
kjv_line: Suffer me that I may speak;

hebrew_line: לֹא־מַ֭יִם עָיֵ֣ף תַּשְׁקֶ֑ה וּ֝מֵרָעֵ֗ב תִּֽמְנַֽע־לָֽחֶם׃

hebrew_line: תַּעְתִּ֣יר אֵ֭לָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶ֑ךָּ
kjv_line: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear

hebrew_line: וְֽתִגְזַר־א֭וֹמֶר וְיָ֣קָם לָ֑ךְ
kjv_line: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established

hebrew_line: מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי וְאֶמְצָאֵ֑הוּ אָ֝ב֗וֹא עַד־תְּכוּנָתֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

hebrew_line: עַל־כֵּ֭ן מִפָּנָ֣יו אֶבָּהֵ֑ל אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן וְאֶפְחַ֥ד מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

hebrew_line: לָא֡וֹר יָ֘ק֤וּם רוֹצֵ֗חַ יִֽקְטָל־עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וּ֝בַלַּ֗יְלָה

hebrew_line: יִתֶּן־ל֣וֹ לָ֭בֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵ֑ן וְ֝עֵינֵ֗יהוּ עַל־דַּרְכֵיהֶֽם׃

hebrew_line: וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝יָּד֗וֹ בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח׃

kjv_line: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

kjv_line: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

hebrew_line: אֶשְׂחַ֣ק אֲ֭לֵהֶם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ינוּ וְא֥וֹר פָּ֝נַ֗י
kjv_line: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance

kjv_line: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army,

hebrew_line: מִן־גֵּ֥ו יְגֹרָ֑שׁוּ יָרִ֥יעוּ עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃
kjv_line: They were driven forth from among men, they cried after them as after a thief;

hebrew_line: בֵּין־שִׂיחִ֥ים יִנְהָ֑קוּ תַּ֖חַת חָר֣וּל יְסֻפָּֽחוּ׃

hebrew_line: בְּרָב־כֹּ֭חַ יִתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ לְבוּשִׁ֑י כְּפִ֖י כֻתָּנְתִּ֣י יַֽאַזְרֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

hebrew_line: אֲשַׁוַּ֣ע אֵ֭לֶיךָ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֵ֑נִי
kjv_line: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear

hebrew_line: תִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי אֶל־ר֭וּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵ֑נִי

hebrew_line: הֲלֹא־ה֭וּא יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑י וְֽכָל־צְעָדַ֥י יִסְפּֽוֹר׃

kjv_line: What then shall I do when God riseth up?

hebrew_line: כְּ֭תֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָ֣ה תִפּ֑וֹל וְ֝אֶזְרֹעִ֗י מִקָּנָ֥ה תִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
kjv_line: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.

hebrew_line: בַּ֭חוּץ לֹא־יָלִ֣ין גֵּ֑ר דְּ֝לָתַ֗י לָאֹ֥רַח אֶפְתָּֽח׃
kjv_line: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.

hebrew_line: מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַי אַגִּידֶ֑נּוּ כְּמוֹ־נָ֝גִ֗יד אֲקָרֲבֶֽנּוּ׃
kjv_line: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.

hebrew_line: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה־לִּ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵּעִ֣י אַף־אָֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

hebrew_line: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע־נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכָל־דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה׃
kjv_line: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

hebrew_line: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם׃
kjv_line: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

hebrew_line: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל־אֱל֨וֹהַּ׀ וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ
kjv_line: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable

hebrew_line: רֶ֤גַע׀ יָמֻתוּ֮ וַחֲצ֪וֹת לָ֥יְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁ֣וּ עָ֣ם וְיַעֲבֹ֑רוּ
kjv_line: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away:

hebrew_line: וְה֤וּא יַשְׁקִ֨ט׀ וּמִ֥י יַרְשִׁ֗עַ
kjv_line: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble?

hebrew_line: וְיַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נִים וּמִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ

hebrew_line: מֵ֭רֹב עֲשׁוּקִ֣ים יַזְעִ֑יקוּ יְשַׁוְּע֖וּ מִזְּר֣וֹעַ רַבִּֽים׃
kjv_line: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

kjv_line: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.

kjv_line: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

hebrew_line: אַחֲרָ֤יו׀ יִשְׁאַג־ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם בְּק֣וֹל גְּאוֹנ֑וֹ

hebrew_line: יַחְלְמ֣וּ בְ֭נֵיהֶם יִרְבּ֣וּ בַבָּ֑ר

hebrew_line: סֶ֣לַע יִ֭שְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָ֑ן עַֽל־שֶׁן־סֶ֝֗לַע וּמְצוּדָֽה׃

hebrew_line: אֱזָר־נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗

kjv_line: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.

hebrew_line: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִ֣ים תְּלַהֵ֑ט וְ֝לַ֗הַב מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא׃

kjv_line: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

kjv_line: it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

hebrew_line: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּרָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃
kjv_line: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

hebrew_line: בַּֽ֭מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗יו לְֽחֵלְכָ֥ה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ׃

kjv_line: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time

kjv_line: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure:

hebrew_line: מִן־גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן־ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃

hebrew_line: תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן וְאֶל־מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם

hebrew_line: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן

hebrew_line: תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן

hebrew_line: יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃

hebrew_line: בַּעֲב֤וּר׀ יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
kjv_line: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.

hebrew_line: מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?

hebrew_line: תִּפְתַּח־אֶ֭רֶץ וַתִּבְלַ֣ע דָּתָ֑ן
kjv_line: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan,

hebrew_line: וַתִּבְעַר־אֵ֥שׁ בַּעֲדָתָ֑ם לֶ֝הָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט רְשָׁעִֽים׃
kjv_line: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

hebrew_line: יֽ֭וֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמוֹסְר֖וֹתֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃
kjv_line: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

hebrew_line: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑ם
kjv_line: He sent his word, and healed

hebrew_line: יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃
kjv_line: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

hebrew_line: מִי־חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמָר־אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבּֽוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
kjv_line: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.

hebrew_line: יִֽהְיֽוּ־יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר׃
kjv_line: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

hebrew_line: וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ
kjv_line: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg:

hebrew_line: תְּהִי־ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח
kjv_line: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle

hebrew_line: יְקַֽלְלוּ־הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ
kjv_line: Let them curse, but bless

hebrew_line: מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ׃
kjv_line: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

hebrew_line: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־לֵבָ֑ב
kjv_line: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart,

hebrew_line: רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה׀ וְכָעָ֗ס
kjv_line: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved;

hebrew_line: שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס
kjv_line: he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away:

hebrew_line: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ׀ נְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ יָ֗הּ מֵֽעַתָּ֥ה וְעַד־עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
kjv_line: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.

hebrew_line: לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי־אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה
kjv_line: I shall not die, but live,

hebrew_line: פִּתְחוּ־לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא־בָ֝ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ׃
kjv_line: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:

hebrew_line: א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃
kjv_line: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

hebrew_line: אֵ֤ל׀ יְהוָה֮ וַיָּ֪אֶר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ־חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד־קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
kjv_line: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

hebrew_line: בְּחֻקֹּתֶ֥יךָ אֶֽשְׁתַּעֲשָׁ֑ע לֹ֭א אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

hebrew_line: גְּמֹ֖ל עַֽל־עַבְדְּךָ֥ אֶֽחְיֶ֗ה וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה דְבָרֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

hebrew_line: גַּל־עֵינַ֥י וְאַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

hebrew_line: דֶּֽרֶךְ־פִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָשִׂ֗יחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

hebrew_line: הֲ֭בִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָ֥ה תֽוֹרָתֶ֗ךָ
kjv_line: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law;

hebrew_line: הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

hebrew_line: יְבֹא֣וּנִי רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ וְאֶֽחְיֶ֑ה כִּי־תֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ שַֽׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃
kjv_line: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

hebrew_line: יְהִֽי־לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃
kjv_line: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

hebrew_line: כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּ֑נִי וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה עֵד֥וּת פִּֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

hebrew_line: נִדְב֣וֹת פִּ֭י רְצֵה־נָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.

hebrew_line: סָמְכֵ֣נִי כְאִמְרָתְךָ֣ וְאֶֽחְיֶ֑ה
kjv_line: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live:

hebrew_line: סְעָדֵ֥נִי וְאִוָּשֵׁ֑עָה
kjv_line: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe:

hebrew_line: עַבְדְּךָ־אָ֥נִי הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אֵדְעָ֗ה עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

hebrew_line: פְּנֵה־אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

hebrew_line: פְּ֭דֵנִי מֵעֹ֣שֶׁק אָדָ֑ם וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

hebrew_line: הֲבִינֵ֥נִי וְאֶחְיֶֽה׃
kjv_line: give me understanding, and I shall live.

hebrew_line: קְרָאתִ֥יךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

hebrew_line: ק֭וֹלִי שִׁמְעָ֣ה כְחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.

hebrew_line: רִיבָ֣ה רִ֭יבִי וּגְאָלֵ֑נִי לְאִמְרָתְךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

hebrew_line: תִּקְרַ֤ב רִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה כִּדְבָרְךָ֥ הֲבִינֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.

hebrew_line: תְּֽחִי־נַ֭פְשִׁי וּֽתְהַֽלְלֶ֑ךָּ וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ יַעֲזְרֻֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

hebrew_line: מַה־יִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭ךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִ֥יף לָ֗ךְ לָשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃
kjv_line: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

hebrew_line: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ בְּחַסְדְּךָ֣ בָטַחְתִּי֮ יָ֤גֵ֥ל לִבִּ֗י בִּֽישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥ךָ אָשִׁ֥ירָה לַיהוָ֑ה
kjv_line: I will sing unto the LORD,

hebrew_line: וְֽ֭כֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ יֶ֑שַׁע וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יהָ רַנֵּ֥ן יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
kjv_line: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

hebrew_line: תִּדְבַּ֥ק־לְשׁוֹנִ֨י׀ לְחִכִּי֮ אִם־לֹ֪א אֶ֫זְכְּרֵ֥כִי
kjv_line: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth;

hebrew_line: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ אוֹדְךָ֥ בְכָל־לִבִּ֑י נֶ֖גֶד אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲזַמְּרֶֽךָּ׃
kjv_line: A Psalm of David. I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

hebrew_line: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־הֵיכַ֪ל קָדְשְׁךָ֡ וְא֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ֥
kjv_line: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness

hebrew_line: אָ֭נָ֥ה אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵרוּחֶ֑ךָ וְ֝אָ֗נָה מִפָּנֶ֥יךָ אֶבְרָֽח׃
kjv_line: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

hebrew_line: אֶשָּׂ֥א כַנְפֵי־שָׁ֑חַר אֶ֝שְׁכְּנָ֗ה בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית יָֽם׃
kjv_line: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

hebrew_line: אֶ֭סְפְּרֵם מֵח֣וֹל יִרְבּ֑וּן
kjv_line: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand:

hebrew_line: הֲלֽוֹא־מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֥ה׀ אֶשְׂנָ֑א וּ֝בִתְקוֹמְמֶ֗יךָ אֶתְקוֹטָֽט׃
kjv_line: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

hebrew_line: יִמּ֥וֹטוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם גֶּֽחָ֫לִ֥ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יַפִּלֵ֑ם בְּ֝מַהֲמֹר֗וֹת
kjv_line: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits,

hebrew_line: יֶֽהֶלְמֵֽנִי־צַדִּ֨יק׀ חֶ֡סֶד וְֽיוֹכִיחֵ֗נִי
kjv_line: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove

hebrew_line: יִפְּל֣וּ בְמַכְמֹרָ֣יו רְשָׁעִ֑ים יַ֥חַד אָ֝נֹכִ֗י
kjv_line: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal

hebrew_line: אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃
kjv_line: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

hebrew_line: הוֹדִיעֵ֗נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ־ז֥וּ אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־אֵ֝לֶיךָ
kjv_line: cause me to know the way wherein

hebrew_line: יְ֭הוָה הַט־שָׁמֶ֣יךָ וְתֵרֵ֑ד
kjv_line: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down:

hebrew_line: גַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃
kjv_line: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

hebrew_line: בְּר֣וֹק בָּ֭רָק וּתְפִיצֵ֑ם שְׁלַ֥ח חִ֝צֶּ֗יךָ וּתְהֻמֵּֽם׃
kjv_line: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

hebrew_line: פְּצֵ֣נִי וְ֭הַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים מִ֝יַּ֗ד בְּנֵ֣י נֵכָֽר׃
kjv_line: rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

hebrew_line: פְּצֵ֥נִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי֮ מִיַּ֪ד בְּֽנֵי־נֵ֫כָ֥ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁ֑וְא וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם
kjv_line: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand

hebrew_line: תֵּצֵ֣א ר֭וּחוֹ יָשֻׁ֣ב לְאַדְמָת֑וֹ
kjv_line: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth;

hebrew_line: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּבָר֣וֹ וְיַמְסֵ֑ם
kjv_line: He sendeth out his word, and melteth

hebrew_line: יַשֵּׁ֥ב ר֝וּח֗וֹ יִזְּלוּ־מָֽיִם׃
kjv_line: them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

hebrew_line: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃
kjv_line: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

hebrew_line: יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣וֹ בְמָח֑וֹל בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנּ֗וֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

hebrew_line: מִ֭לְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י יֵצֵ֑א עֵ֝ינֶ֗יךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֥ינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
kjv_line: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

hebrew_line: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי
kjv_line: He sent from above, he took

hebrew_line: עִם־חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃
kjv_line: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

hebrew_line: אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם
kjv_line: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken

hebrew_line: אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא־יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם
kjv_line: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise:

hebrew_line: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי֮ מֵרִ֪יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵנִי לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם
kjv_line: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen:

hebrew_line: לְשֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑י בְּנֵֽי־נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לִֽי׃
kjv_line: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

hebrew_line: בְּנֵי־נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
kjv_line: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

hebrew_line: שְׁגִיא֥וֹת מִֽי־יָבִ֑ין מִֽנִּסְתָּר֥וֹת נַקֵּֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

hebrew_line: אַֽל־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִ֣י אָ֣ז אֵיתָ֑ם
kjv_line: sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright,

hebrew_line: יִֽתֶּן־לְךָ֥ כִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל־עֲצָתְךָ֥ יְמַלֵּֽא׃
kjv_line: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

hebrew_line: ר֣וּמָה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעֻזֶּ֑ךָ נָשִׁ֥ירָה וּֽ֝נְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

hebrew_line: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ
kjv_line: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver

hebrew_line: הֵ֥מָּה יַ֝בִּ֗יטוּ יִרְאוּ־בִֽי׃
kjv_line: they look and stare upon me.

hebrew_line: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל־תִּרְחָ֑ק אֱ֝יָלוּתִ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃
kjv_line: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

hebrew_line: יֹאכְל֬וּ עֲנָוִ֨ים׀ וְיִשְׂבָּ֗עוּ
kjv_line: The meek shall eat and be satisfied:

hebrew_line: מִי־זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃
kjv_line: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

hebrew_line: פְּנֵה־אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי־יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

hebrew_line: בְּחָנֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה וְנַסֵּ֑נִי צָרְפָ֖ה כִלְיוֹתַ֣י וְלִבִּֽי׃
kjv_line: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

hebrew_line: אֶרְחַ֣ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּ֑י וַאֲסֹבְבָ֖ה אֶת־מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃
kjv_line: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

hebrew_line: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ יְהוָ֤ה׀ אוֹרִ֣י וְ֭יִשְׁעִי מִמִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהוָ֥ה מָֽעוֹז־חַ֝יַּ֗י מִמִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד׃
kjv_line: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

hebrew_line: וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑י וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י אֲהוֹדֶֽנּוּ׃
kjv_line: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

hebrew_line: ק֤וֹל יְהוָ֨ה׀ יְחוֹלֵ֣ל אַיָּלוֹת֮ וַֽיֶּחֱשֹׂ֪ף יְעָ֫ר֥וֹת וּבְהֵיכָל֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ
kjv_line: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple

hebrew_line: בְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל־אֵב֣וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

hebrew_line: תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: sake lead me, and guide me.

hebrew_line: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם׀ בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת׃
kjv_line: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

hebrew_line: אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨׀ וְֽאוֹרְךָ֗
kjv_line: I will instruct thee and teach

hebrew_line: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר זַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

hebrew_line: בַּ֭יהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ׃
kjv_line: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

hebrew_line: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו׃
kjv_line: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

hebrew_line: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ רִיבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־יְרִיבַ֑י לְ֝חַ֗ם אֶת־לֹֽחֲמָֽי׃
kjv_line: A Psalm of David. Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

hebrew_line: יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֣וֹר וְיַחְפְּר֑וּ
kjv_line: let them be turned back and brought to confusion

hebrew_line: וְרִשְׁתּ֣וֹ אֲשֶׁר־טָמַ֣ן תִּלְכְּד֑וֹ בְּ֝שׁוֹאָ֗ה יִפָּל־בָּֽהּ׃
kjv_line: and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

hebrew_line: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּקָהָ֣ל רָ֑ב בְּעַ֖ם עָצ֣וּם אֲהַֽלְלֶֽךָּ׃
kjv_line: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

hebrew_line: שָׁפְטֵ֣נִי כְ֭צִדְקְךָ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֗י וְאַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִֽי׃
kjv_line: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

hebrew_line: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ׀ יַחְדָּו֮ שְׂמֵחֵ֪י רָעָ֫תִ֥י יִֽלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹ֥שֶׁת וּכְלִמָּ֑ה
kjv_line: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour

hebrew_line: וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל־יְהוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן־לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ׃
kjv_line: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

hebrew_line: צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ׃
kjv_line: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

hebrew_line: שְׁמָר־תָּ֭ם וּרְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי־אַחֲרִ֖ית לְאִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
kjv_line: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

hebrew_line: יְפַלְּטֵ֣ם מֵ֭רְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם
kjv_line: them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save

hebrew_line: מִכָּל־פְּשָׁעַ֥י הַצִּילֵ֑נִי חֶרְפַּ֥ת נָ֝בָ֗ל אַל־תְּשִׂימֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

hebrew_line: הָשַׁ֣ע מִמֶּ֣נִּי וְאַבְלִ֑יגָה
kjv_line: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

hebrew_line: יִרְא֣וּ רַבִּ֣ים וְיִירָ֑אוּ
kjv_line: many shall see it, and fear,

hebrew_line: לִסְפּ֫וֹתָ֥הּ יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃
kjv_line: to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

hebrew_line: יְהוָ֤ה׀ יִשְׁמְרֵ֣הוּ וִֽ֭יחַיֵּהוּ וְאֻשַּׁ֣ר בָּאָ֑רֶץ
kjv_line: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth:

hebrew_line: יֵצֵ֖א לַח֣וּץ יְדַבֵּֽר׃
kjv_line: to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

hebrew_line: מַה־תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ וַתֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י
kjv_line: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in

hebrew_line: הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ע֥וֹד אוֹדֶ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּע֥וֹת פָּנָֽיו׃
kjv_line: me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

hebrew_line: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י עָלַי֮ נַפְשִׁ֪י תִשְׁתּ֫וֹחָ֥ח עַל־כֵּ֗ן אֶ֭זְכָּרְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יַרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֝חֶרְמוֹנִ֗ים מֵהַ֥ר מִצְעָֽר׃
kjv_line: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

hebrew_line: מַה־תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה־תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י
kjv_line: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within

hebrew_line: הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי׃
kjv_line: me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

hebrew_line: שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ וְרִ֘יבָ֤ה רִיבִ֗י מִגּ֥וֹי לֹא־חָסִ֑יד
kjv_line: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation:

hebrew_line: שְׁלַח־אוֹרְךָ֣ וַ֭אֲמִתְּךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּנִי
kjv_line: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead

hebrew_line: מַה־תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה־תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י
kjv_line: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within

hebrew_line: הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי׃
kjv_line: me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

hebrew_line: בְּ֭ךָ צָרֵ֣ינוּ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽינוּ׃
kjv_line: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

hebrew_line: לָֽמָּה־פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח עָנְיֵ֣נוּ וְֽלַחֲצֵֽנוּ׃
kjv_line: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

hebrew_line: וְיִתְאָ֣ו הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יָפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּי־ה֥וּא אֲ֝דֹנַ֗יִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִי־לֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

hebrew_line: קֶ֣שֶׁת יְ֭שַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית עֲ֝גָל֗וֹת
kjv_line: he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; the chariot

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּ֭ירָא כִּֽי־יַעֲשִׁ֣ר אִ֑ישׁ כִּֽי־יִ֝רְבֶּה כְּב֣וֹד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

hebrew_line: אוֹכִיחֲךָ֖ וְאֶֽעֶרְכָ֣ה לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

hebrew_line: בִּֽינוּ־נָ֣א זֹ֭את שֹׁכְחֵ֣י אֱל֑וֹהַּ פֶּן־אֶ֝טְרֹ֗ף
kjv_line: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces,

hebrew_line: הֶ֭רֶב כַּבְּסֵ֣נִי מֵעֲוֹנִ֑י וּֽמֵחַטָּאתִ֥י טַהֲרֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

hebrew_line: תְּחַטְּאֵ֣נִי בְאֵז֣וֹב וְאֶטְהָ֑ר
kjv_line: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean:

hebrew_line: תְּ֝כַבְּסֵ֗נִי וּמִשֶּׁ֥לֶג אַלְבִּֽין׃
kjv_line: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

hebrew_line: הַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָ֑י וְֽכָל־עֲוֹ֖נֹתַ֣י מְחֵֽה׃
kjv_line: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

hebrew_line: יַחְתְּךָ֣ וְיִסָּחֲךָ֣ מֵאֹ֑הֶל
kjv_line: he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place,

hebrew_line: וְיִרְא֖וּ צַדִּיקִ֥ים וְיִירָ֗אוּ
kjv_line: The righteous also shall see, and fear,

hebrew_line: בִּנְדָבָ֥ה אֶזְבְּחָה־לָּ֑ךְ א֤וֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה כִּי־טֽוֹב׃
kjv_line: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.

hebrew_line: אָרִ֖יד בְּשִׂיחִ֣י וְאָהִֽימָה׃
kjv_line: me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

hebrew_line: יִשְׁמַ֤ע׀ אֵ֨ל׀ וְֽיַעֲנֵם֮ וְיֹ֤שֵׁ֥ב קֶ֗דֶם
kjv_line: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old.

hebrew_line: הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עַל־יְהוָ֨ה׀ יְהָבְךָ֮ וְה֪וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥ךָ
kjv_line: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain

hebrew_line: חָנֵּ֣נִי אֱ֭לֹהִים כִּֽי־שְׁאָפַ֣נִי אֱנ֑וֹשׁ כָּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם לֹחֵ֥ם יִלְחָצֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: To the chief Musician upon Jonathelemrechokim, Michtam of David, when the Philistines took him in Gath. Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

hebrew_line: אָ֥֨ז יָ֘שׁ֤וּבוּ אוֹיְבַ֣י אָ֭חוֹר בְּי֣וֹם אֶקְרָ֑א
kjv_line: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back:

kjv_line: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down,

hebrew_line: וְיָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב
kjv_line: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog,

hebrew_line: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ אָשִׁ֣יר עֻזֶּךָ֮ וַאֲרַנֵּ֥ן לַבֹּ֗קֶר חַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ
kjv_line: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning:

kjv_line: O prepare which may preserve him.
Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest

hebrew_line: כָּל־הָאָ֤רֶץ׀ יִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְ֭ךָ וִֽיזַמְּרוּ־לָ֑ךְ
kjv_line: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing

hebrew_line: בַּ֭נָּהָר יַֽעַבְר֣וּ בְרָ֑גֶל שָׁ֝֗ם נִשְׂמְחָה־בּֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

hebrew_line: אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְחָנֵּ֥נוּ וִֽיבָרְכֵ֑נוּ
kjv_line: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song. God be merciful unto us, and bless

hebrew_line: יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אוֹיְבָ֑יו
kjv_line: To the chief Musician, A Psalm or Song of David. Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered:

hebrew_line: וְֽצַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַֽ֭עַלְצוּ לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים
kjv_line: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God:

kjv_line: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate

hebrew_line: וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵֽעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־צַר־לִ֝֗י מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

hebrew_line: וְזֶ֣רַע עֲ֭בָדָיו יִנְחָל֑וּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁ֝מ֗וֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָֽהּ׃
kjv_line: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

hebrew_line: יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ
kjv_line: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion,

hebrew_line: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥נִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵ֑נִי
kjv_line: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape:

hebrew_line: אֱ֭לֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃
kjv_line: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

hebrew_line: וּֽמִתְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ תָּשׁ֥וּב תַּעֲלֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

hebrew_line: גַּם־אֲנִ֤י׀ אוֹדְךָ֣ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּךָ֪ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְךָ֣ בְכִנּ֑וֹר
kjv_line: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp,

hebrew_line: תְּרַנֵּ֣נָּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי כִּ֣י אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּ֑ךְ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּדִֽיתָ׃
kjv_line: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

hebrew_line: לְ֭פָנָיו יִכְרְע֣וּ צִיִּ֑ים וְ֝אֹיְבָ֗יו עָפָ֥ר יְלַחֵֽכוּ׃
kjv_line: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

hebrew_line: בַּעֲצָתְךָ֥ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְ֝אַחַ֗ר כָּב֥וֹד תִּקָּחֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

hebrew_line: אַל־תָּרִ֣ימוּ לַמָּר֣וֹם קַרְנְכֶ֑ם תְּדַבְּר֖וּ בְצַוָּ֣אר עָתָֽק׃
kjv_line: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

hebrew_line: וַ֭אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְעֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
kjv_line: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

hebrew_line: וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי־אֵ֑ל וּמִצְוֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃
kjv_line: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

hebrew_line: הֵ֤ן הִכָּה־צ֨וּר׀ וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מַיִם֮ וּנְחָלִ֪ים יִ֫שְׁטֹ֥פוּ

hebrew_line: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֹן֮ וְֽלֹא־יַ֫שְׁחִ֥ית

hebrew_line: אַֽל־תִּזְכָּר־לָנוּ֮ עֲוֹנֹ֪ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ

hebrew_line: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭דוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝אֹיְבֵ֗ינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ־לָֽמוֹ׃

kjv_line: and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

hebrew_line: תְּ֝חַיֵּ֗נוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֥ נִקְרָֽא׃

hebrew_line: הָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃
kjv_line: cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

hebrew_line: שְֽׂאוּ־זִ֭מְרָה וּתְנוּ־תֹ֑ף כִּנּ֖וֹר נָעִ֣ים עִם־נָֽבֶל׃
kjv_line: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

hebrew_line: הַרְאֵ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝יֶשְׁעֲךָ֗ תִּתֶּן־לָֽנוּ׃

hebrew_line: יָק֤וּמוּ׀ יוֹד֬וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃

hebrew_line: זְ֭רַמְתָּם שֵׁנָ֣ה יִהְי֑וּ בַּ֝בֹּ֗קֶר כֶּחָצִ֥יר יַחֲלֹֽף׃
kjv_line: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

hebrew_line: בַּ֭בֹּקֶר יָצִ֣יץ וְחָלָ֑ף לָ֝עֶ֗רֶב יְמוֹלֵ֥ל וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃

kjv_line: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

hebrew_line: וִיהִ֤י׀ נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עָ֫לֵ֥ינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗ינוּ

kjv_line: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

hebrew_line: עַל־כַּפַּ֥יִם יִשָּׂא֑וּנְךָ פֶּן־תִּגֹּ֖ף בָּאֶ֣בֶן רַגְלֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

hebrew_line: עַל־שַׁ֣חַל וָפֶ֣תֶן תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְתַנִּֽין׃
kjv_line: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

hebrew_line: מִֽי־יָק֣וּם לִ֭י עִם־מְרֵעִ֑ים מִֽי־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב לִ֝י עִם־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

hebrew_line: וַיָּ֤שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֨ם׀ אֶת־אוֹנָ֗ם וּבְרָעָתָ֥ם יַצְמִיתֵ֑ם

hebrew_line: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ־מִ֝נְחָ֗ה

hebrew_line: אַף־תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל־תִּמּ֑וֹט
