hebrew_line: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ׀ כָּל־עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֝וֹ כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
kjv_line: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

hebrew_line: יִשְׁמַ֣ע חָ֭כָם וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶ֑קַח וְ֝נָב֗וֹן
kjv_line: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding

hebrew_line: מְ֭זִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹ֥ר עָלֶ֗יךָ תְּבוּנָ֥ה תִנְצְרֶֽכָּה׃
kjv_line: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

hebrew_line: בְּ֭נִי תּוֹרָתִ֣י אַל־תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח וּ֝מִצְוֹתַ֗י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽךָ׃
kjv_line: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:

hebrew_line: אַל־תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת־יְ֝הוָ֗ה
kjv_line: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD,

hebrew_line: בְּ֭נִי אַל־יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּמְזִמָּֽה׃
kjv_line: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

hebrew_line: אַל־תַּעַזְבֶ֥הָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶ֑ךָּ אֱהָבֶ֥הָ וְתִצְּרֶֽךָּ׃
kjv_line: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

hebrew_line: סַלְסְלֶ֥הָ וּֽתְרוֹמְמֶ֑ךָּ
kjv_line: Exalt her, and she shall promote

hebrew_line: הַחֲזֵ֣ק בַּמּוּסָ֣ר אַל־תֶּ֑רֶף
kjv_line: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go:

hebrew_line: פְּרָעֵ֥הוּ אַל־תַּעֲבָר־בּ֑וֹ
kjv_line: Avoid it, pass

hebrew_line: אַל־יַלִּ֥יזוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝מְרֵ֗ם בְּת֣וֹךְ לְבָבֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.

hebrew_line: פַּ֭לֵּס מַעְגַּ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ יִכֹּֽנוּ׃
kjv_line: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

hebrew_line: אַֽל־תֵּט־יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול הָסֵ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מֵרָֽע׃
kjv_line: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

hebrew_line: לֵֽךְ־אֶל־נְמָלָ֥ה עָצֵ֑ל רְאֵ֖ה דְרָכֶ֣יהָ וַחֲכָֽם׃
kjv_line: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

hebrew_line: עַל־כֵּ֗ן פִּ֭תְאֹם יָב֣וֹא אֵיד֑וֹ פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר
kjv_line: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken

hebrew_line: בְּ֭נִי שְׁמֹ֣ר אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֹתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ׃
kjv_line: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

hebrew_line: שְׁמֹ֣ר מִצְוֹתַ֣י וֶחְיֵ֑ה וְ֝תוֹרָתִ֗י כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.

hebrew_line: וָאֵ֤רֶא בַפְּתָאיִ֗ם אָ֘בִ֤ינָה בַבָּנִ֗ים נַ֣עַר חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃
kjv_line: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

hebrew_line: וְהֶחֱזִ֣יקָה בּ֭וֹ וְנָ֣שְׁקָה־לּ֑וֹ
kjv_line: So she caught him, and kissed

hebrew_line: בִּ֭י מְלָכִ֣ים יִמְלֹ֑כוּ וְ֝רוֹזְנִ֗ים יְחֹ֣קְקוּ צֶֽדֶק׃
kjv_line: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

hebrew_line: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁרֵ֗י דְּרָכַ֥י יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃
kjv_line: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.

hebrew_line: אַל־תּ֣וֹכַח לֵ֭ץ פֶּן־יִשְׂנָאֶ֑ךָּ הוֹכַ֥ח לְ֝חָכָ֗ם וְיֶאֱהָבֶֽךָּ׃
kjv_line: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

hebrew_line: תֵּ֣ן לְ֭חָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם־ע֑וֹד
kjv_line: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser:

hebrew_line: מִי־פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה וַחֲסַר־לֵ֝֗ב וְאָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

hebrew_line: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יִרְע֣וּ רַבִּ֑ים וֶֽ֝אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּחֲסַר־לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ׃
kjv_line: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

hebrew_line: לְֽפִי־שִׂ֭כְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל־אִ֑ישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה־לֵ֝֗ב יִהְיֶ֥ה לָבֽוּז׃
kjv_line: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

hebrew_line: שְֽׂפַת־אֱ֭מֶת תִּכּ֣וֹן לָעַ֑ד וְעַד־אַ֝רְגִּ֗יעָה לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃
kjv_line: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

hebrew_line: יַבְאִ֥ישׁ וְיַחְפִּֽיר׃
kjv_line: man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

hebrew_line: חַ֭טָּאִים תְּרַדֵּ֣ף רָעָ֑ה וְאֶת־צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יְשַׁלֶּם־טֽוֹב׃
kjv_line: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

hebrew_line: בֵּ֣ית רְ֭שָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵ֑ד וְאֹ֖הֶל יְשָׁרִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיחַ׃
kjv_line: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

hebrew_line: מַֽעֲנֶה־רַּ֭ךְ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה וּדְבַר־עֶ֝֗צֶב יַעֲלֶה־אָֽף׃
kjv_line: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

hebrew_line: בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח׀ יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה׃
kjv_line: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

hebrew_line: לְֽ֭תַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ נִפְרָ֑ד בְּכָל־תּ֝וּשִׁיָּ֗ה יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
kjv_line: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

hebrew_line: שִׂפְתֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל יָבֹ֣אֽוּ בְרִ֑יב וּ֝פִ֗יו לְֽמַהֲלֻמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃
kjv_line: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

hebrew_line: מִגְדַּל־עֹ֭ז שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בּֽוֹ־יָר֖וּץ צַדִּ֣יק וְנִשְׂגָּֽב׃
kjv_line: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

hebrew_line: תַּחֲנוּנִ֥ים יְדַבֶּר־רָ֑שׁ וְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר יַעֲנֶ֥ה עַזּֽוֹת׃
kjv_line: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

hebrew_line: ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝דָ֗ל מֵרֵ֥עהוּ יִפָּרֵֽד׃
kjv_line: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

hebrew_line: שְׁמַ֣ע עֵ֭צָה וְקַבֵּ֣ל מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝מַ֗עַן תֶּחְכַּ֥ם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

hebrew_line: לֵ֣ץ תַּ֭כֶּה וּפֶ֣תִי יַעְרִ֑ם
kjv_line: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware:

hebrew_line: מֵ֭חֹרֶף עָצֵ֣ל לֹא־יַחֲרֹ֑שׁ וְשָׁאַ֖ל בַּקָּצִ֣יר וָאָֽיִן׃
kjv_line: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.

hebrew_line: אַל־תֶּֽאֱהַ֣ב שֵׁ֭נָה פֶּן־תִּוָּרֵ֑שׁ פְּקַ֖ח עֵינֶ֣יךָ שְֽׂבַֽע־לָֽחֶם׃
kjv_line: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

hebrew_line: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְיֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן
kjv_line: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out;

hebrew_line: בְּאָזְנֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל אַל־תְּדַבֵּ֑ר כִּֽי־יָ֝ב֗וּז לְשֵׂ֣כֶל מִלֶּֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּמְנַ֣ע מִנַּ֣עַר מוּסָ֑ר כִּֽי־תַכֶּ֥נּוּ בַ֝שֵּׁ֗בֶט
kjv_line: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod,

hebrew_line: אַ֭תָּה בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט תַּכֶּ֑נּוּ וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּצִּֽיל׃
kjv_line: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.

hebrew_line: יִֽשְׂמַח־אָבִ֥יךָ וְאִמֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝תָגֵ֗ל יֽוֹלַדְתֶּֽךָ׃
kjv_line: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.

hebrew_line: אַף־הִ֭יא כְּחֶ֣תֶף תֶּֽאֱרֹ֑ב וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים בְּאָדָ֥ם תּוֹסִֽף׃
kjv_line: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.

hebrew_line: אַל־תֵּ֥רֶא יַיִן֮ כִּ֪י יִתְאַ֫דָּ֥ם
kjv_line: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red,

hebrew_line: יְרָֽא־אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה בְּנִ֣י וָמֶ֑לֶךְ עִם־שׁ֝וֹנִ֗ים אַל־תִּתְעָרָֽב׃
kjv_line: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:

hebrew_line: וְלַמּוֹכִיחִ֥ים יִנְעָ֑ם וַֽ֝עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם תָּב֥וֹא בִרְכַּת־טֽוֹב׃
kjv_line: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

hebrew_line: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽשָׂה־לִ֭י כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־לּ֑וֹ אָשִׁ֖יב לָאִ֣ישׁ כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.

hebrew_line: וָֽאֶחֱזֶ֣ה אָ֭נֹכִֽי אָשִׁ֣ית לִבִּ֑י
kjv_line: Then I saw, and considered it well:

hebrew_line: בִּשְׁחוּת֥וֹ הֽוּא־יִפּ֑וֹל וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִנְחֲלוּ־טֽוֹב׃
kjv_line: he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.

hebrew_line: יָר֥וּן וְשָׂמֵֽחַ׃
kjv_line: doth sing and rejoice.

hebrew_line: כָּל־ר֭וּחוֹ יוֹצִ֣יא כְסִ֑יל וְ֝חָכָ֗ם בְּאָח֥וֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽנָּה׃
kjv_line: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.

hebrew_line: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ וִֽינִיחֶ֑ךָ
kjv_line: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest;

hebrew_line: בִּ֭דְבָרִים לֹא־יִוָּ֣סֶר עָ֑בֶד כִּֽי־יָ֝בִ֗ין
kjv_line: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.

hebrew_line: אַל־תּ֥וֹסְףְּ עַל־דְּבָרָ֑יו פֶּן־יוֹכִ֖יחַ בְּךָ֣ וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ׃
kjv_line: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת׃
kjv_line: of thee; deny me them not before I die:

hebrew_line: שָׁ֤וְא׀ וּֽדְבַר־כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר אַל־תִּֽתֶּן־לִ֑י
kjv_line: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches;

hebrew_line: עַ֤יִן׀ תִּֽלְעַ֣ג לְאָב֮ וְתָב֪וּז לִֽיקֲּהַ֫ת־אֵ֥ם
kjv_line: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother,

hebrew_line: אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּלִבִּ֔י לְכָה־נָּ֛א אֲנַסְּכָ֛ה בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה
kjv_line: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth,

hebrew_line: גַּ֥ם כָּל־יָמָ֖יו בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ יֹאכֵ֑ל וְכָעַ֥ס הַרְבֵּ֖ה
kjv_line: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּבָּהֵ֤ל מִפָּנָיו֙ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ אַֽל־תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בְּדָבָ֣ר רָ֑ע
kjv_line: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing;

hebrew_line: זְב֣וּבֵי מָ֔וֶת יַבְאִ֥ישׁ יַבִּ֖יעַ שֶׁ֣מֶן רוֹקֵ֑חַ
kjv_line: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour:

hebrew_line: לֹא־יֵדַ֤ע הָאָדָם֙ מַה־שֶׁיִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִֽהְיֶה֙ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֔יו
kjv_line: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after

hebrew_line: שַׁלַּ֥ח לַחְמְךָ֖ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַמָּ֑יִם כִּֽי־בְרֹ֥ב הַיָּמִ֖ים תִּמְצָאֶֽנּוּ׃
kjv_line: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.

hebrew_line: שְׂמַ֧ח בָּח֣וּר בְּיַלְדוּתֶ֗יךָ וִֽיטִֽיבְךָ֤ לִבְּךָ֙ בִּימֵ֣י בְחוּרוֹתֶ֔ךָ
kjv_line: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth,

hebrew_line: וְהָסֵ֥ר כַּ֙עַס֙ מִלִּבֶּ֔ךָ וְהַעֲבֵ֥ר רָעָ֖ה מִבְּשָׂרֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־הַיַּלְד֥וּת וְהַֽשַּׁחֲר֖וּת הָֽבֶל׃
kjv_line: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.

hebrew_line: וְיָנֵ֤אץ הַשָּׁקֵד֙ וְיִסְתַּבֵּ֣ל הֶֽחָגָ֔ב
kjv_line: and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden,

hebrew_line: אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים יְרָא֙ וְאֶת־מִצְוֹתָ֣יו שְׁמ֔וֹר כִּי־זֶ֖ה כָּל־הָאָדָֽם׃
kjv_line: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

hebrew_line: צְֽאִי־לָ֞ךְ בְּעִקְבֵ֣י הַצֹּ֗אן וּרְעִי֙ אֶת־גְּדִיֹּתַ֔יִךְ
kjv_line: go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids

hebrew_line: אֶֽמְצָאֲךָ֤ בַחוּץ֙ אֶשָׁ֣קְךָ֔ גַּ֖ם לֹא־יָב֥וּזוּ לִֽי׃
kjv_line: when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.

hebrew_line: אֶנְהָֽגֲךָ֗ אֲבִֽיאֲךָ֛ אֶל־בֵּ֥ית אִמִּ֖י
kjv_line: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house,

hebrew_line: מַֽה־נַּעֲשֶׂה֙ לַאֲחֹתֵ֔נוּ בַּיּ֖וֹם שֶׁיְּדֻבַּר־בָּֽהּ׃
kjv_line: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?

hebrew_line: עַ֣ל מֶ֥ה תֻכּ֛וּ ע֖וֹד תּוֹסִ֣יפוּ סָרָ֑ה כָּל־רֹ֣אשׁ לָחֳלִ֔י
kjv_line: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick,

hebrew_line: לִמְד֥וּ הֵיטֵ֛ב דִּרְשׁ֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט אַשְּׁר֣וּ חָמ֑וֹץ
kjv_line: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed,

hebrew_line: לְכוּ־נָ֛א וְנִוָּֽכְחָ֖ה יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה
kjv_line: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD:

hebrew_line: ה֚וֹי אֶנָּחֵ֣ם מִצָּרַ֔י וְאִנָּקְמָ֖ה מֵאוֹיְבָֽי׃
kjv_line: Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:

hebrew_line: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה יָדִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְאֶצְרֹ֥ף כַּבֹּ֖ר סִיגָ֑יִךְ וְאָסִ֖ירָה כָּל־בְּדִילָֽיִךְ׃
kjv_line: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:

hebrew_line: וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְאָמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ׀ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־הַר־יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב
kjv_line: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob;

hebrew_line: וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
kjv_line: and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתִּ֥י נְעָרִ֖ים שָׂרֵיהֶ֑ם וְתַעֲלוּלִ֖ים יִמְשְׁלוּ־בָֽם׃
kjv_line: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.

hebrew_line: מַה־לָּכֶם֙ תְּדַכְּא֣וּ עַמִּ֔י וּפְנֵ֥י עֲנִיִּ֖ים תִּטְחָ֑נוּ
kjv_line: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith

hebrew_line: יַקְרִ֑יבוּ עַ֚ד אֶ֣פֶס מָק֔וֹם וְהֽוּשַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לְבַדְּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
kjv_line: that lay till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!

hebrew_line: שֵׁכָ֣ר יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ מְאַחֲרֵ֣י בַנֶּ֔שֶׁף יַ֖יִן יַדְלִיקֵֽם׃
kjv_line: that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!

hebrew_line: וְתִקְרַ֣ב וְתָב֗וֹאָה עֲצַ֛ת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְנֵדָֽעָה׃
kjv_line: it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!

hebrew_line: וְשָׁ֥רַק ל֖וֹ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֥ה מְהֵרָ֖ה קַ֥ל יָבֽוֹא׃
kjv_line: and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:

hebrew_line: יִשְׁאַ֨ג כַּכְּפִירִ֤ים וְיִנְהֹם֙ וְיֹאחֵ֣ז טֶ֔רֶף
kjv_line: they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey,

hebrew_line: וּמִ֣י יֵֽלֶךְ־לָ֑נוּ וָאֹמַ֖ר הִנְנִ֥י שְׁלָחֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: Then said I, Here am I; send me.

hebrew_line: וּרְא֥וּ רָא֖וֹ וְאַל־תֵּדָֽעוּ׃
kjv_line: not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.

hebrew_line: הַשְׁמֵן֙ לֵב־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאָזְנָ֥יו הַכְבֵּ֖ד
kjv_line: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy,

hebrew_line: וְעֵינָ֣יו הָשַׁ֑ע פֶּן־יִרְאֶ֨ה בְעֵינָ֜יו
kjv_line: and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes,

hebrew_line: וּלְבָב֥וֹ יָבִ֛ין וָשָׁ֖ב
kjv_line: and understand with their heart, and convert,

hebrew_line: נַעֲלֶ֤ה בִֽיהוּדָה֙ וּנְקִיצֶ֔נָּה
kjv_line: Let us go up against Judah, and vex

hebrew_line: וְנַבְקִעֶ֖נָּה אֵלֵ֑ינוּ וְנַמְלִ֥יךְ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ אֵ֖ת בֶּן־טָֽבְאַֽל׃
kjv_line: it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִשְׁרֹ֤ק יְהוָה֙ לַזְּב֔וּב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּקְצֵ֖ה יְאֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt,

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא יְחַיֶּה־אִ֛ישׁ עֶגְלַ֥ת בָּקָ֖ר וּשְׁתֵּי־צֹֽאן׃
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;

hebrew_line: לֹֽא־תָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּה יִרְאַ֖ת שָׁמִ֣יר וָשָׁ֑יִת וְהָיָה֙ לְמִשְׁלַ֣ח שׁ֔וֹר
kjv_line: there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen,

hebrew_line: וְחָלַ֤ף בִּֽיהוּדָה֙ שָׁטַ֣ף וְעָבַ֔ר עַד־צַוָּ֖אר
kjv_line: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, even to the neck;

hebrew_line: עֻ֥צוּ עֵצָ֖ה וְתֻפָ֑ר
kjv_line: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought;

hebrew_line: וְכָ֥שְׁלוּ בָ֖ם רַבִּ֑ים וְנָפְל֣וּ וְנִשְׁבָּ֔רוּ וְנוֹקְשׁ֖וּ
kjv_line: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared,

hebrew_line: צ֖וֹר תְּעוּדָ֑ה חֲת֥וֹם תּוֹרָ֖ה בְּלִמֻּדָֽי׃
kjv_line: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

hebrew_line: וְחִכִּ֙יתִי֙ לַיהוָ֔ה הַמַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנָ֖יו מִבֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְקִוֵּ֖יתִֽי־לֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֤י הָעָם֙ כְּמַאֲכֹ֣לֶת אֵ֔שׁ אִ֥ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֖יו לֹ֥א יַחְמֹֽלוּ׃
kjv_line: and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.

hebrew_line: וַיִּגְזֹ֤ר עַל־יָמִין֙ וְרָעֵ֔ב
kjv_line: And he shall snatch on the right hand,

hebrew_line: בְּג֤וֹי חָנֵף֙ אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔נּוּ וְעַל־עַ֥ם עֶבְרָתִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ
kjv_line: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge,

hebrew_line: לָ֠כֵן יְשַׁלַּ֨ח הָאָד֜וֹן יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת בְּמִשְׁמַנָּ֖יו רָז֑וֹן וְתַ֧חַת כְּבֹד֛וֹ יֵקַ֥ד יְקֹ֖ד כִּיק֥וֹד אֵֽשׁ׃
kjv_line: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּירָ֥א עַמִּ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב צִיּ֖וֹן מֵֽאַשּׁ֑וּר בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט יַכֶּ֔כָּה
kjv_line: O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod,

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יָס֤וּר סֻבֳּלוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל שִׁכְמֶ֔ךָ
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder,

hebrew_line: וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ בְּמִישׁ֖וֹר לְעַנְוֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְהִֽכָּה־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּ֔יו
kjv_line: and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth,

hebrew_line: יִרְבְּצ֣וּ יַלְדֵיהֶ֑ן וְאַרְיֵ֖ה כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹֽאכַל־תֶּֽבֶן׃
kjv_line: their young ones shall lie down and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

hebrew_line: יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ לֹֽא־יְקַנֵּ֣א אֶת־יְהוּדָ֔ה
kjv_line: shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah,

hebrew_line: עַ֤ל הַר־נִשְׁפֶּה֙ שְֽׂאוּ־נֵ֔ס הָרִ֥ימוּ ק֖וֹל לָהֶ֑ם
kjv_line: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice

hebrew_line: הָנִ֣יפוּ יָ֔ד וְיָבֹ֖אוּ פִּתְחֵ֥י נְדִיבִֽים׃
kjv_line: unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

hebrew_line: עַל־כֵּן֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם אַרְגִּ֔יז וְתִרְעַ֥שׁ הָאָ֖רֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָ֑הּ בְּעֶבְרַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת
kjv_line: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts,

hebrew_line: וְרָבְצוּ־שָׁ֣ם צִיִּ֔ים וּמָלְא֥וּ בָתֵּיהֶ֖ם אֹחִ֑ים
kjv_line: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures;

hebrew_line: וְנִלְוָ֤ה הַגֵּר֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְנִסְפְּח֖וּ עַל־בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹֽב׃
kjv_line: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

hebrew_line: וּלְקָח֣וּם עַמִּים֮ וֶהֱבִיא֣וּם אֶל־מְקוֹמָם֒
kjv_line: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place:

hebrew_line: אֶעֱלֶ֖ה עַל־בָּ֣מֳתֵי עָ֑ב אֶדַּמֶּ֖ה לְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃
kjv_line: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.

hebrew_line: בַּל־יָקֻ֙מוּ֙ וְיָ֣רְשׁוּ אָ֔רֶץ וּמָלְא֥וּ פְנֵֽי־תֵבֵ֖ל עָרִֽים׃
kjv_line: that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

hebrew_line: כִּ֣י׀ מַעֲלֵ֣ה הַלּוּחִ֗ית בִּבְכִי֙ יַֽעֲלֶה־בּ֔וֹ כִּ֚י דֶּ֣רֶךְ חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם
kjv_line: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim

hebrew_line: סַתְּרִי֙ נִדָּחִ֔ים נֹדֵ֖ד אַל־תְּגַלִּֽי׃
kjv_line: hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.

hebrew_line: יָג֤וּרוּ בָךְ֙ נִדָּחַ֔י מוֹאָ֛ב הֱוִי־סֵ֥תֶר לָ֖מוֹ
kjv_line: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert

hebrew_line: עַל־כֵּ֡ן אֶבְכֶּ֞ה בִּבְכִ֤י יַעְזֵר֙ גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה אֲרַיָּ֙וֶךְ֙ דִּמְעָתִ֔י
kjv_line: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears,

hebrew_line: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִדַּ֖ל כְּב֣וֹד יַעֲקֹ֑ב
kjv_line: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin,

hebrew_line: וְגָ֥עַר בּ֖וֹ וְנָ֣ס מִמֶּרְחָ֑ק
kjv_line: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off,

hebrew_line: וְסִכְסַכְתִּ֤י מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אִישׁ־בְּאָחִ֖יו
kjv_line: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother,

hebrew_line: וְנִשְּׁתוּ־מַ֖יִם מֵֽהַיָּ֑ם וְנָהָ֖ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
kjv_line: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.

hebrew_line: וְעָֽבְדוּ֙ זֶ֣בַח וּמִנְחָ֔ה וְנָדְרוּ־נֵ֥דֶר לַֽיהוָ֖ה
kjv_line: and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD,

hebrew_line: עַל־כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֛רְתִּי שְׁע֥וּ מִנִּ֖י אֲמָרֵ֣ר בַּבֶּ֑כִי
kjv_line: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly,

hebrew_line: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתִּ֣יו כֻּתָּנְתֶּ֗ךָ וְאַבְנֵֽטְךָ֙ אֲחַזְּקֶ֔נּוּ וּמֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֖ אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּיָד֑וֹ
kjv_line: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand:

hebrew_line: עִבְר֖וּ תַּרְשִׁ֑ישָׁה הֵילִ֖ילוּ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי אִֽי׃
kjv_line: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.

hebrew_line: הַֽמְעֻשָּׁקָ֞ה בְּתוּלַ֣ת בַּת־צִיד֗וֹן כִּתִּים֙ ק֣וּמִי עֲבֹ֔רִי
kjv_line: O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim;

hebrew_line: קְחִ֥י כִנּ֛וֹר סֹ֥בִּי עִ֖יר זוֹנָ֣ה נִשְׁכָּחָ֑ה
kjv_line: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten;

hebrew_line: הֵיטִ֤יבִי נַגֵּן֙ הַרְבִּי־שִׁ֔יר לְמַ֖עַן תִּזָּכֵֽרִי׃
kjv_line: make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֞ה מִקֵּ֣ץ׀ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יִפְקֹ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת־צֹ֔ר
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre,

hebrew_line: בַּשִּׁ֖יר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתּוּ־יָ֑יִן יֵמַ֥ר שֵׁכָ֖ר לְשֹׁתָֽיו׃
kjv_line: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

hebrew_line: וְהִֽתְנוֹדְדָ֖ה כַּמְּלוּנָ֑ה וְכָבַ֤ד עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔הּ
kjv_line: and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy

hebrew_line: וְסֻגְּר֖וּ עַל־מַסְגֵּ֑ר וּמֵרֹ֥ב יָמִ֖ים יִפָּקֵֽדוּ׃
kjv_line: and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

hebrew_line: וְחָֽפְרָה֙ הַלְּבָנָ֔ה וּבוֹשָׁ֖ה הַֽחַמָּ֑ה
kjv_line: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed,

hebrew_line: אֲרֽוֹמִמְךָ֙ אוֹדֶ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֔ כִּ֥י עָשִׂ֖יתָ פֶּ֑לֶא
kjv_line: I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful

hebrew_line: וְיֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נוּ זֶ֤ה יְהוָה֙ קִוִּ֣ינוּ ל֔וֹ נָגִ֥ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֖ה בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: for him, and he will save us: this is the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

hebrew_line: מֵתִים֙ בַּל־יִחְי֔וּ רְפָאִ֖ים בַּל־יָקֻ֑מוּ
kjv_line: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise:

hebrew_line: יְשׁוּעֹת֙ בַּל־נַ֣עֲשֶׂה אֶ֔רֶץ וּבַֽל־יִפְּל֖וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃
kjv_line: we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

hebrew_line: חֲבִ֥י כִמְעַט־רֶ֖גַע עַד־יַעֲבָר זָֽעַם׃
kjv_line: about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

hebrew_line: אֶפְשְׂעָ֥ה בָ֖הּ אֲצִיתֶ֥נָּה יָּֽחַד׃
kjv_line: I would go through them, I would burn them together.

hebrew_line: שָׁ֣ם יִרְעֶ֥ה עֵ֛גֶל וְשָׁ֥ם יִרְבָּ֖ץ
kjv_line: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down,

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִתָּקַע֮ בְּשׁוֹפָ֣ר גָּדוֹל֒
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown,

hebrew_line: וְ֠הָמַם גִּלְגַּ֧ל עֶגְלָת֛וֹ וּפָרָשָׁ֖יו לֹֽא־יְדֻקֶּֽנּוּ׃
kjv_line: it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.

hebrew_line: וַהֲצִיק֖וֹתִי לַֽאֲרִיאֵ֑ל וְהָיְתָ֤ה תַֽאֲנִיָּה֙ וַֽאֲנִיָּ֔ה
kjv_line: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow:

hebrew_line: וְחָנִ֥יתִי כַדּ֖וּר עָלָ֑יִךְ וְצַרְתִּ֤י עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ מֻצָּ֔ב
kjv_line: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount,

hebrew_line: וְיָדְע֥וּ תֹֽעֵי־ר֖וּחַ בִּינָ֑ה וְרוֹגְנִ֖ים יִלְמְדוּ־לֶֽקַח׃
kjv_line: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.

hebrew_line: עַתָּ֗ה בּ֣וֹא כָתְבָ֥הּ עַל־ל֛וּחַ אִתָּ֖ם
kjv_line: Now go, write it before them in a table,

hebrew_line: נְכֹח֑וֹת דַּבְּרוּ־לָ֣נוּ חֲלָק֔וֹת חֲז֖וּ מַהֲתַלּֽוֹת׃
kjv_line: not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:

hebrew_line: ס֚וּרוּ מִנֵּי־דֶ֔רֶךְ הַטּ֖וּ מִנֵּי־אֹ֑רַח הַשְׁבִּ֥יתוּ מִפָּנֵ֖ינוּ
kjv_line: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, to cease from before us.

hebrew_line: וְעַל־קַ֣ל נִרְכָּ֔ב עַל־כֵּ֖ן יִקַּ֥לּוּ רֹדְפֵיכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

hebrew_line: בָּכ֣וֹ לֹֽא־תִבְכֶּ֗ה חָנ֤וֹן יָחְנְךָ֙ לְק֣וֹל זַעֲקֶ֔ךָ
kjv_line: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry;

hebrew_line: וְהִשְׁמִ֨יעַ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ה֣וֹד קוֹל֗וֹ וְנַ֤חַת זְרוֹעוֹ֙ יַרְאֶ֔ה
kjv_line: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm,

hebrew_line: וַֽיהוָ֞ה יַטֶּ֣ה יָד֗וֹ וְכָשַׁ֤ל עוֹזֵר֙ וְנָפַ֣ל עָזֻ֔ר וְיַחְדָּ֖ו
kjv_line: When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, together.

hebrew_line: וְשָׁכַ֥ן בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בַּכַּרְמֶ֥ל תֵּשֵֽׁב׃
kjv_line: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

hebrew_line: מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּיָפְי֖וֹ תֶּחֱזֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֑יךָ תִּרְאֶ֖ינָה אֶ֥רֶץ מַרְחַקִּֽים׃
kjv_line: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.

hebrew_line: עֵינֶיךָ֩ תִרְאֶ֨ינָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם נָוֶ֣ה שַׁאֲנָ֗ן אֹ֤הֶל בַּל־יִצְעָן֙ בַּל־יִסַּ֤ע יְתֵֽדֹתָיו֙ לָנֶ֔צַח
kjv_line: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed,

hebrew_line: וִירֵשׁ֙וּהָ֙ קָאַ֣ת וְקִפּ֔וֹד וְיַנְשׁ֥וֹף וְעֹרֵ֖ב יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָ֑הּ
kjv_line: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell

hebrew_line: וְתָגֵ֧ל עֲרָבָ֛ה וְתִפְרַ֖ח כַּחֲבַצָּֽלֶת׃
kjv_line: for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

hebrew_line: פָּרֹ֨חַ תִּפְרַ֜ח וְתָגֵ֗ל אַ֚ף גִּילַ֣ת וְרַנֵּ֔ן
kjv_line: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy

hebrew_line: וְהָיָה־שָׁ֞ם מַסְל֣וּל וָדֶ֗רֶךְ וְדֶ֤רֶךְ הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִקָּ֣רֵא לָ֔הּ
kjv_line: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness;

hebrew_line: לֹא־יִהְיֶ֨ה שָׁ֜ם אַרְיֵ֗ה וּפְרִ֤יץ חַיּוֹת֙ בַּֽל־יַעֲלֶ֔נָּה
kjv_line: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up

hebrew_line: לֹ֥א תִמָּצֵ֖א שָׁ֑ם וְהָלְכ֖וּ גְּאוּלִֽים׃
kjv_line: thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:

hebrew_line: וּפְדוּיֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה יְשֻׁב֗וּן וּבָ֤אוּ צִיּוֹן֙ בְּרִנָּ֔ה
kjv_line: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs

hebrew_line: וְאִכְל֤וּ אִישׁ־גַּפְנוֹ֙ וְאִ֣ישׁ תְּאֵנָת֔וֹ וּשְׁת֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ מֵי־בוֹרֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;

hebrew_line: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗ית זִרְע֧וּ וְקִצְר֛וּ וְנִטְע֥וּ כְרָמִ֖ים
kjv_line: of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards,

hebrew_line: כֵּ֥ן יְשַׁבֵּ֖ר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑י מִיּ֥וֹם עַד־לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

hebrew_line: כְּס֤וּס עָגוּר֙ כֵּ֣ן אֲצַפְצֵ֔ף אֶהְגֶּ֖ה כַּיּוֹנָ֑ה
kjv_line: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove:

hebrew_line: מָֽה־אֲדַבֵּ֥ר וְאָֽמַר־לִ֖י וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑ה
kjv_line: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done

hebrew_line: וְיִמְרְח֥וּ עַֽל־הַשְּׁחִ֖ין וְיֶֽחִי׃
kjv_line: and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.

hebrew_line: וּמֵאַ֙יִן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ מֵאֶ֧רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֛ה בָּ֥אוּ אֵלַ֖י מִבָּבֶֽל׃
kjv_line: and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.

hebrew_line: כְּרֹעֶה֙ עֶדְר֣וֹ יִרְעֶ֔ה בִּזְרֹעוֹ֙ יְקַבֵּ֣ץ טְלָאִ֔ים
kjv_line: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm,

hebrew_line: הֲל֤וֹא תֵֽדְעוּ֙ הֲל֣וֹא תִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הֲל֛וֹא הֻגַּ֥ד מֵרֹ֖אשׁ לָכֶ֑ם
kjv_line: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning?

hebrew_line: וְאֶל־מִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְאֶשְׁוֶ֑ה יֹאמַ֖ר קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
kjv_line: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.

hebrew_line: שְׂאוּ־מָר֨וֹם עֵינֵיכֶ֤ם וּרְאוּ֙ מִי־בָרָ֣א אֵ֔לֶּה הַמּוֹצִ֥יא בְמִסְפָּ֖ר צְבָאָ֑ם
kjv_line: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number:

hebrew_line: יִתֵּ֨ן לְפָנָ֤יו גּוֹיִם֙ וּמְלָכִ֣ים יַ֔רְדְּ
kjv_line: gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings?

hebrew_line: יִֽהְי֥וּ כְאַ֛יִן וְיֹאבְד֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י רִיבֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.

hebrew_line: תְּבַקְשֵׁם֙ וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָאֵ֔ם אַנְשֵׁ֖י מַצֻּתֶ֑ךָ
kjv_line: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended

hebrew_line: תִּזְרֵם֙ וְר֣וּחַ תִּשָּׂאֵ֔ם
kjv_line: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away,

hebrew_line: וְלֹ֣א יָר֔וּץ עַד־יָשִׂ֥ים בָּאָ֖רֶץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט
kjv_line: nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth:

hebrew_line: וְאֶצָּרְךָ֗ וְאֶתֶּנְךָ֛ לִבְרִ֥ית עָ֖ם לְא֥וֹר גּוֹיִֽם׃
kjv_line: and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

hebrew_line: יִשְׂא֤וּ מִדְבָּר֙ וְעָרָ֔יו חֲצֵרִ֖ים תֵּשֵׁ֣ב קֵדָ֑ר
kjv_line: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit:

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּירָ֖א כִּ֣י אִתְּךָ־אָ֑נִי מִמִּזְרָח֙ אָבִ֣יא זַרְעֶ֔ךָ
kjv_line: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east,

hebrew_line: וְרִֽאשֹׁנ֖וֹת יַשְׁמִיעֻ֑נוּ יִתְּנ֤וּ עֵֽדֵיהֶם֙ וְיִצְדָּ֔קוּ
kjv_line: this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified:

hebrew_line: יַחְדָּ֤ו יִשְׁכְּבוּ֙ בַּל־יָק֔וּמוּ דָּעֲכ֖וּ כַּפִּשְׁתָּ֥ה כָבֽוּ׃
kjv_line: they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

hebrew_line: הִנְנִ֨י עֹשֶׂ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ עַתָּ֣ה תִצְמָ֔ח הֲל֖וֹא תֵֽדָע֑וּהָ
kjv_line: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it?

hebrew_line: הַזְכִּירֵ֕נִי נִשָּׁפְטָ֖ה
kjv_line: Put me in remembrance: let us plead

hebrew_line: וַאֲחַלֵּ֖ל שָׂ֣רֵי קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאֶתְּנָ֤ה לַחֵ֙רֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב
kjv_line: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse,

hebrew_line: וְחָרָשִׁ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה מֵֽאָדָ֑ם יִֽתְקַבְּצ֤וּ כֻלָּם֙ יַֽעֲמֹ֔דוּ
kjv_line: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up;

hebrew_line: יִסְגָּד ל֤וֹ וְיִשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלָ֔יו וְיֹאמַר֙ הַצִּילֵ֔נִי
kjv_line: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver

hebrew_line: הַרְעִ֤יפוּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וּשְׁחָקִ֖ים יִזְּלוּ־צֶ֑דֶק
kjv_line: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness:

hebrew_line: תִּפְתַּח־אֶ֣רֶץ וְיִפְרוּ־יֶ֗שַׁע וּצְדָקָ֤ה תַצְמִ֙יחַ֙ יַ֔חַד אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּרָאתִֽיו׃
kjv_line: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD have created it.

hebrew_line: הֽוּא־יִבְנֶ֤ה עִירִי֙ וְגָלוּתִ֣י יְשַׁלֵּ֔חַ לֹ֤א בִמְחִיר֙
kjv_line: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price

hebrew_line: עָלַ֤יִךְ יַעֲבֹ֙רוּ֙ וְלָ֣ךְ יִֽהְי֔וּ
kjv_line: shall come over

hebrew_line: וְאֵלַ֤יִךְ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ֙ אֵלַ֣יִךְ יִתְפַּלָּ֔לוּ
kjv_line: and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication

hebrew_line: פְּנוּ־אֵלַ֥י וְהִוָּשְׁע֖וּ כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י אֲנִי־אֵ֖ל וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃
kjv_line: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.

hebrew_line: וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י בָהֶ֜ם א֗וֹת וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֣י מֵהֶ֣ם׀ פְּ֠לֵיטִים אֶֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֞ם תַּרְשִׁ֨ישׁ פּ֥וּל
kjv_line: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul,

hebrew_line: אֲצַוֶּ֑ךָּ אַל־תֵּחַת֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם פֶּֽן־אֲחִתְּךָ֖ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
kjv_line: unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.

hebrew_line: כָּל־אֹכְלָ֣יו יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ רָעָ֛ה תָּבֹ֥א אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃
kjv_line: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD.

hebrew_line: וְקֵדָ֛ר שִׁלְח֥וּ וְהִֽתְבּוֹנְנ֖וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּרְא֕וּ
kjv_line: and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.

hebrew_line: עָלָיו֙ יִשְׁאֲג֣וּ כְפִרִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ קוֹלָ֑ם וַיָּשִׁ֤יתוּ אַרְצוֹ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה
kjv_line: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste:

hebrew_line: לֵאמֹ֡ר הֵ֣ן יְשַׁלַּ֣ח אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ֩ וְהָלְכָ֨ה מֵאִתּ֜וֹ וְהָיְתָ֣ה לְאִישׁ־אַחֵ֗ר הֲיָשׁ֤וּב אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ ע֔וֹד
kjv_line: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again?

hebrew_line: שְׂאִֽי־עֵינַ֨יִךְ עַל־שְׁפָיִ֜ם וּרְאִ֗י אֵיפֹה֙ לֹ֣א שֻׁכַּ֔בְתְּ
kjv_line: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with.

hebrew_line: וְאָנֹכִ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֵ֚יךְ אֲשִׁיתֵ֣ךְ בַּבָּנִ֔ים וְאֶתֶּן־לָךְ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֔ה
kjv_line: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land,

hebrew_line: נִשְׁכְּבָ֣ה בְּבָשְׁתֵּ֗נוּ וּֽתְכַסֵּנוּ֮ כְּלִמָּתֵנוּ֒
kjv_line: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth

hebrew_line: הִמֹּ֣לוּ לַיהֹוָ֗ה וְהָסִ֙רוּ֙ עָרְל֣וֹת לְבַבְכֶ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה
kjv_line: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah

hebrew_line: עַל־זֹ֛את חִגְר֥וּ שַׂקִּ֖ים סִפְד֣וּ וְהֵילִ֑ילוּ
kjv_line: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl:

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה יֹאבַ֥ד לֵב־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD, that the heart of the king shall perish,

hebrew_line: כַּבְּסִ֨י מֵרָעָ֤ה לִבֵּךְ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן תִּוָּשֵׁ֑עִי
kjv_line: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved.

hebrew_line: הַזְכִּ֣ירוּ לַגּוֹיִ֗ם הִנֵּה֙ הַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם
kjv_line: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem,

hebrew_line: עַל־זֹאת֙ תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ וְקָדְר֥וּ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם
kjv_line: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens be black:

hebrew_line: וְאַ֨תְּ שָׁד֜וּד מַֽה־תַּעֲשִׂ֗י כִּֽי־תִלְבְּשִׁ֨י שָׁנִ֜י כִּי־תַעְדִּ֣י עֲדִי־זָהָ֗ב כִּֽי־תִקְרְעִ֤י בַפּוּךְ֙ עֵינַ֔יִךְ
kjv_line: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting,

hebrew_line: שׁוֹטְט֞וּ בְּחוּצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּרְאוּ־נָ֤א וּדְעוּ֙
kjv_line: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know,

hebrew_line: וְהָמ֥וּ גַלָּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א יַעַבְרֻֽנְהוּ׃
kjv_line: it: and though the waves though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?

hebrew_line: וּבִתְק֙וֹעַ֙ תִּקְע֣וּ שׁוֹפָ֔ר וְעַל־בֵּ֥ית הַכֶּ֖רֶם
kjv_line: and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, of fire in Beth-haccerem:

hebrew_line: עַל־מִ֨י אֲדַבְּרָ֤ה וְאָעִ֙ידָה֙ וְיִשְׁמָ֔עוּ
kjv_line: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear?

hebrew_line: לָכֵ֞ן יִפְּל֧וּ בַנֹּפְלִ֛ים בְּעֵת־פְּקַדְתִּ֥ים יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ
kjv_line: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down,

hebrew_line: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה עִמְדוּ֩ עַל־דְּרָכִ֨ים וּרְא֜וּ וְשַׁאֲל֣וּ׀ לִנְתִב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֗ם אֵי־זֶ֨ה דֶ֤רֶךְ הַטּוֹב֙
kjv_line: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way,

hebrew_line: וּמִצְא֥וּ מַרְגּ֖וֹעַ לְנַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נֵלֵֽךְ׃
kjv_line: and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.

hebrew_line: קֶ֣שֶׁת וְכִיד֞וֹן יַחֲזִ֗יקוּ אַכְזָרִ֥י הוּא֙ וְלֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ
kjv_line: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy;

hebrew_line: תַּמְרוּרִ֑ים כִּ֣י פִתְאֹ֔ם יָבֹ֥א הַשֹּׁדֵ֖ד עָלֵֽינוּ׃
kjv_line: most bitter for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.

hebrew_line: הֵיטִ֥יבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם וּמַֽעַלְלֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשַׁכְּנָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
kjv_line: Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

hebrew_line: עֹלוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם סְפ֥וּ עַל־זִבְחֵיכֶ֖ם וְאִכְל֥וּ בָשָֽׂר׃
kjv_line: Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.

hebrew_line: וְלֹ֣א יָק֑וּמוּ אִם־יָשׁ֖וּב
kjv_line: and not arise? shall he turn away,

hebrew_line: לָכֵ֞ן יִפְּל֣וּ בַנֹּפְלִ֗ים בְּעֵ֧ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֛ם יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ
kjv_line: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down,

hebrew_line: וְנִדְּמָה־שָּׁ֑ם כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֤ינוּ הֲדִמָּ֙נוּ֙ וַיַּשְׁקֵ֣נוּ מֵי־רֹ֔אשׁ כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לַיהוָֽה׃
kjv_line: and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.

hebrew_line: מִֽי־יִתְּנֵ֣נִי בַמִּדְבָּ֗ר מְלוֹן֙ אֹֽרְחִ֔ים וְאֶֽעֶזְבָה֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י וְאֵלְכָ֖ה מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם
kjv_line: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them!

hebrew_line: וְאֶל־הַחֲכָמ֥וֹת שִׁלְח֖וּ וְתָבֽוֹאנָה׃
kjv_line: and send for cunning women, that they may come:

hebrew_line: וְתִקַּ֥ח אָזְנְכֶ֖ם דְּבַר־פִּ֑יו וְלַמֵּ֤דְנָה בְנֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ נֶ֔הִי
kjv_line: and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing,

hebrew_line: מִקִּצְפּוֹ֙ תִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹֽא־יָכִ֥לוּ גוֹיִ֖ם זַעְמֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.

hebrew_line: יַסְּרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה אַךְ־בְּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אַל־בְּאַפְּךָ֖ פֶּן־תַּמְעִטֵֽנִי׃
kjv_line: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.

hebrew_line: לָצֵ֣את מִמֶּ֑נָּה וְזָעֲק֣וּ אֵלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א אֶשְׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
kjv_line: to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.

hebrew_line: לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶ֖ה לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־אָבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲנָת֖וֹת
kjv_line: of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth,

hebrew_line: וּבָחַנְתָּ֥ לִבִּ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ הַתִּקֵם֙ כְּצֹ֣אן לְטִבְחָ֔ה
kjv_line: me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter,

hebrew_line: וְנִפַּצְתִּים֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֜יו וְהָאָב֧וֹת וְהַבָּנִ֛ים יַחְדָּ֖ו נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה לֹֽא־אֶחְמ֧וֹל
kjv_line: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity,

hebrew_line: תְּנוּ֩ לַיהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֤ם כָּבוֹד֙ בְּטֶ֣רֶם יַחְשִׁ֔ךְ
kjv_line: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness,

hebrew_line: וְקִוִּיתֶ֤ם לְאוֹר֙ וְשָׂמָ֣הּ לְצַלְמָ֔וֶת
kjv_line: and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death,

hebrew_line: וְדָמֹ֨עַ תִּדְמַ֜ע וְתֵרַ֤ד עֵינִי֙ דִּמְעָ֔ה
kjv_line: and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears,

hebrew_line: אַתָּ֧ה יָדַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֗ה זָכְרֵ֤נִי וּפָקְדֵ֙נִי֙ וְהִנָּ֤קֶם לִי֙ מֵרֹ֣דְפַ֔י
kjv_line: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors;

hebrew_line: מְמוֹתֵ֨י תַחֲלֻאִ֜ים יָמֻ֗תוּ לֹ֤א יִסָּֽפְדוּ֙
kjv_line: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented;

hebrew_line: וְלֹ֤א יִרְאֶה֙ כִּֽי־יָבֹ֣א חֹ֔ם
kjv_line: and shall not see when heat cometh,

hebrew_line: אָ֑נִי הָבִ֤יא עֲלֵיהֶם֙ י֣וֹם רָעָ֔ה וּמִשְׁנֶ֥ה שִׁבָּר֖וֹן שָׁבְרֵֽם׃
kjv_line: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

hebrew_line: וְהִצַּ֧תִּי אֵ֣שׁ בִּשְׁעָרֶ֗יהָ וְאָֽכְלָ֛ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם
kjv_line: then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem,

hebrew_line: כְּרֽוּחַ־קָדִ֥ים אֲפִיצֵ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב עֹ֧רֶף וְלֹֽא־פָנִ֛ים אֶרְאֵ֖ם
kjv_line: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face,

hebrew_line: הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וּשְׁמַ֖ע לְק֥וֹל יְרִיבָֽי׃
kjv_line: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.

hebrew_line: לָכֵן֩ תֵּ֨ן אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֜ם לָרָעָ֗ב וְהַגִּרֵם֮ עַל־יְדֵי־חֶרֶב֒
kjv_line: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword;

hebrew_line: תִּשָּׁמַ֤ע זְעָקָה֙ מִבָּ֣תֵּיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־תָבִ֧יא עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם גְּד֖וּד פִּתְאֹ֑ם
kjv_line: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly

hebrew_line: וְאֶת־כָּל־יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל וְהִגְלָ֥ם בָּבֶ֖לָה
kjv_line: it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon,

hebrew_line: וּבְזָזוּם֙ וּלְקָח֔וּם
kjv_line: which shall spoil them, and take

hebrew_line: וּבָבֶ֣ל תָּב֗וֹא וְשָׁ֤ם תָּמוּת֙ וְשָׁ֣ם תִּקָּבֵ֔ר אַתָּה֙
kjv_line: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried

hebrew_line: וְהִכָּ֣ם לְפִי־חֶ֔רֶב לֹֽא־יָח֣וּס עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יַחְמֹ֖ל
kjv_line: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity,

hebrew_line: דִּ֤ינוּ לַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְהַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִיַּ֣ד עוֹשֵׁ֑ק
kjv_line: Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor,

hebrew_line: וְאַל־תָּנֻ֖דוּ ל֑וֹ בְּכ֤וּ בָכוֹ֙ לַֽהֹלֵ֔ךְ
kjv_line: neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away:

hebrew_line: שָׁ֣ם יָמ֑וּת וְאֶת־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֥ה עֽוֹד׃
kjv_line: But he shall die and shall see this land no more.

hebrew_line: עֲלִ֤י הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ וּֽצְעָ֔קִי וּבַבָּשָׁ֖ן תְּנִ֣י קוֹלֵ֑ךְ
kjv_line: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan,

hebrew_line: צֶ֣מַח צַדִּ֑יק וּמָ֤לַךְ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ וְהִשְׂכִּ֔יל
kjv_line: a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper,

hebrew_line: בְּיָמָיו֙ תִּוָּשַׁ֣ע יְהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִשְׁכֹּ֣ן לָבֶ֑טַח
kjv_line: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely:

hebrew_line: וּבְנִיתִים֙ וְלֹ֣א אֶהֱרֹ֔ס
kjv_line: and I will build them, and not pull them down;

hebrew_line: אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים כִּֽי־יָשֻׁ֥בוּ אֵלַ֖י בְּכָל־לִבָּֽם׃
kjv_line: and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.

hebrew_line: אֶל־חוֹמֹ֨ת בָּבֶ֜ל שְׂאוּ־נֵ֗ס הַחֲזִ֙יקוּ֙ הַמִּשְׁמָ֔ר
kjv_line: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong,

hebrew_line: וְנָטִ֨יתִי אֶת־יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וְגִלְגַּלְתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־הַסְּלָעִ֔ים
kjv_line: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks,

hebrew_line: שְׂאוּ־נֵ֣ס בָּאָ֗רֶץ תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֤ר בַּגּוֹיִם֙ קַדְּשׁ֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם
kjv_line: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations

hebrew_line: מִנִּ֣י וְאַשְׁכְּנָ֑ז פִּקְד֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ טִפְסָ֔ר הַֽעֲלוּ־ס֖וּס כְּיֶ֥לֶק סָמָֽר׃
kjv_line: Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.

hebrew_line: בְּחֻמָּ֞ם אָשִׁ֣ית אֶת־מִשְׁתֵּיהֶ֗ם וְהִשְׁכַּרְתִּים֙ לְמַ֣עַן יַעֲלֹ֔זוּ
kjv_line: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice,

hebrew_line: וּפָקַדְתִּ֨י עַל־בֵּ֜ל בְּבָבֶ֗ל וְהֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶת־בִּלְעוֹ֙ מִפִּ֔יו
kjv_line: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up:

hebrew_line: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֣א כָל־הָֽעַמִּ֗ים וּרְאוּ֙ מַכְאֹבִ֔י בְּתוּלֹתַ֥י וּבַחוּרַ֖י
kjv_line: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men

hebrew_line: תָּבֹ֨א כָל־רָעָתָ֤ם לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעוֹלֵ֣ל לָ֔מוֹ
kjv_line: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do

hebrew_line: יֵשְׁב֨וּ לָאָ֤רֶץ יִדְּמוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י בַת־צִיּ֔וֹן
kjv_line: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence:

hebrew_line: מָֽה־אֲעִידֵ֞ךְ מָ֣ה אֲדַמֶּה־לָּ֗ךְ הַבַּת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם
kjv_line: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem?

hebrew_line: מָ֤ה אַשְׁוֶה־לָּךְ֙ וַאֲנַֽחֲמֵ֔ךְ
kjv_line: what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort

hebrew_line: אַ֣ךְ בִּ֥י יָשֻׁ֛ב יַהֲפֹ֥ךְ יָד֖וֹ כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
kjv_line: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.

hebrew_line: יֵשֵׁ֤ב בָּדָד֙ וְיִדֹּ֔ם
kjv_line: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence,

hebrew_line: תִּרְדֹּ֤ף בְּאַף֙ וְתַשְׁמִידֵ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת שְׁמֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
kjv_line: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.

hebrew_line: לָ֤מָּה לָנֶ֙צַח֙ תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֔נוּ תַּֽעַזְבֵ֖נוּ לְאֹ֥רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
kjv_line: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתִּ֥י מִכְשׁ֛וֹל לְפָנָ֖יו ה֣וּא יָמ֑וּת
kjv_line: and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die:

hebrew_line: וַאֲסָר֖וּךָ בָּהֶ֑ם וְלֹ֥א תֵצֵ֖א בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
kjv_line: upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

hebrew_line: וּלְשֽׁוֹנְךָ֙ אַדְבִּ֣יק אֶל־חִכֶּ֔ךָ וְנֶֽאֱלַ֔מְתָּ
kjv_line: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb,

hebrew_line: הַשֹּׁמֵ֤עַ׀ יִשְׁמָע֙ וְהֶחָדֵ֣ל׀ יֶחְדָּ֔ל כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃
kjv_line: He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתָּ֥ה אוֹתָ֖הּ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְחַקּוֹתָ֥ עָלֶ֛יהָ עִ֖יר אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
kjv_line: and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתָּ֨ה עָלֶ֧יהָ מַחֲנ֛וֹת וְשִׂים־עָלֶ֥יהָ כָּרִ֖ים סָבִֽיב׃
kjv_line: against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.

hebrew_line: וּבֵ֣ין הָעִ֑יר וַהֲכִינֹתָה֩ אֶת־פָּנֶ֨יךָ אֵלֶ֜יהָ וְהָיְתָ֤ה בַמָּצוֹר֙ וְצַרְתָּ֣ עָלֶ֔יהָ
kjv_line: between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it.

hebrew_line: וְכִלִּיתָ֣ אֶת־אֵ֗לֶּה וְשָׁ֨כַבְתָּ֜ עַל־צִדְּךָ֤ הַיְמָנִי֙ שֵׁנִ֔ית
kjv_line: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side,

hebrew_line: וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ לְךָ֛ מֹאזְנֵ֥י מִשְׁקָ֖ל וְחִלַּקְתָּֽם׃
kjv_line: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the hair.

hebrew_line: יְמֵ֣י הַמָּצ֑וֹר וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֗ית תַּכֶּ֤ה בַחֶ֙רֶב֙ סְבִ֣יבוֹתֶ֔יהָ
kjv_line: when the days of the siege and thou shalt take a third part, and smite about it with a knife:

hebrew_line: וְשָׂרַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בָּאֵ֑שׁ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ תֵצֵא־אֵ֖שׁ אֶל־כָּל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
kjv_line: and burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.

hebrew_line: וְכָלָ֣ה אַפִּ֗י וַהֲנִחוֹתִ֧י חֲמָתִ֛י בָּ֖ם
kjv_line: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest

hebrew_line: וְרָעָב֙ אֹסֵ֣ף עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְשָׁבַרְתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם מַטֵּה־לָֽחֶם׃
kjv_line: you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:

hebrew_line: וְשִׁכְּלֻ֔ךְ וְדֶ֥בֶר וָדָ֖ם יַעֲבָר־בָּ֑ךְ
kjv_line: and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through

hebrew_line: בְּכֹל֙ מוֹשְׁב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם הֶעָרִ֣ים תֶּחֱרַ֔בְנָה וְהַבָּמ֖וֹת תִּישָׁ֑מְנָה
kjv_line: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate;

hebrew_line: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הַכֵּ֨ה בְכַפְּךָ֜ וּרְקַ֤ע בְּרַגְלְךָ֙ וֶֽאֱמָר־אָ֔ח
kjv_line: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas

hebrew_line: הָרָח֞וֹק בַּדֶּ֣בֶר יָמ֗וּת וְהַקָּרוֹב֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפּ֔וֹל
kjv_line: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword;

hebrew_line: וְנָטִ֤יתִי אֶת־יָדִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶת־הָאָ֜רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֤ה
kjv_line: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate,

hebrew_line: וּשְׁפַטְתִּ֖יךְ כִּדְרָכָ֑יִךְ וְנָתַתִּ֣י עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
kjv_line: upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.

hebrew_line: כִּדְרָכַ֜יִךְ עָלַ֣יִךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְתוֹעֲבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֣ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֔יןָ
kjv_line: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst

hebrew_line: כַּסְפָּ֞ם בַּחוּצ֣וֹת יַשְׁלִ֗יכוּ וּזְהָבָם֮ לְנִדָּ֣ה יִֽהְיֶה֒
kjv_line: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed:

hebrew_line: וַהֲסִבּוֹתִ֤י פָנַי֙ מֵהֶ֔ם וְחִלְּל֖וּ אֶת־צְפוּנִ֑י
kjv_line: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret

hebrew_line: וְהֵֽבֵאתִי֙ רָעֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם וְיָרְשׁ֖וּ אֶת־בָּֽתֵּיהֶ֑ם
kjv_line: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses:

hebrew_line: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ גְּא֣וֹן עַזִּ֔ים וְנִחֲל֖וּ מְקַֽדְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
kjv_line: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.

hebrew_line: וּבִקְשׁ֤וּ חָזוֹן֙ מִנָּבִ֔יא וְתוֹרָה֙ תֹּאבַ֣ד מִכֹּהֵ֔ן
kjv_line: then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest,

hebrew_line: הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יִתְאַבָּ֗ל וְנָשִׂיא֙ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ שְׁמָמָ֔ה
kjv_line: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation,

hebrew_line: מִדַּרְכָּ֞ם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ וּבְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֣ם אֶשְׁפְּטֵ֔ם
kjv_line: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge

hebrew_line: וְעוֹד֙ תָּשׁ֣וּב תִּרְאֶ֔ה תּוֹעֵב֖וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
kjv_line: but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.

hebrew_line: ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת
kjv_line: also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations

hebrew_line: ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
kjv_line: turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.

hebrew_line: וְגַם־אֲנִי֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה בְחֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא־תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖י
kjv_line: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare,

hebrew_line: וּלְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אָמַ֣ר בְּאָזְנַ֔י עִבְר֥וּ בָעִ֛יר אַחֲרָ֖יו וְהַכּ֑וּ אַל תָּחֹ֥ס עֵינְכֶ֖ם
kjv_line: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare,

hebrew_line: טַמְּא֣וּ אֶת־הַבַּ֗יִת וּמַלְא֧וּ אֶת־הַחֲצֵר֛וֹת חֲלָלִ֖ים
kjv_line: unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain:

hebrew_line: בֹּא֩ אֶל־בֵּינ֨וֹת לַגַּלְגַּ֜ל אֶל־תַּ֣חַת לַכְּר֗וּב וּמַלֵּ֨א חָפְנֶ֤יךָ גַֽחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ֙ מִבֵּינ֣וֹת לַכְּרֻבִ֔ים
kjv_line: Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims,

hebrew_line: וּזְרֹ֖ק עַל־הָעִ֑יר וַיָּבֹ֖א לְעֵינָֽי׃
kjv_line: and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־זָרִ֑ים וְעָשִׂ֛יתִי בָכֶ֖ם שְׁפָטִֽים׃
kjv_line: thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

hebrew_line: בַּחֶ֣רֶב תִּפֹּ֔לוּ עַל־גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶשְׁפּ֣וֹט אֶתְכֶ֑ם
kjv_line: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel;

hebrew_line: וַהֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י לֵ֤ב הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ מִבְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר׃
kjv_line: you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

hebrew_line: לְעֵ֨ינֵיהֶ֜ם עַל־כָּתֵ֤ף תִּשָּׂא֙ בָּעֲלָטָ֣ה תוֹצִ֔יא
kjv_line: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight:

hebrew_line: וְהַנָּשִׂ֨יא אֲשֶׁר־בְּתוֹכָ֜ם אֶל־כָּתֵ֤ף יִשָּׂא֙ בָּעֲלָטָ֣ה וְיֵצֵ֔א
kjv_line: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth:

hebrew_line: וּפָרַשְׂתִּ֤י אֶת־רִשְׁתִּי֙ עָלָ֔יו וְנִתְפַּ֖שׂ בִּמְצֽוּדָתִ֑י
kjv_line: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare:

hebrew_line: וְכָל־אֲגַפָּ֖יו אֱזָרֶ֣ה לְכָל־ר֑וּחַ וְחֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
kjv_line: And I will scatter toward every wind him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

hebrew_line: וְקָרַעְתִּ֞י אֶת־מִסְפְּחֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת־עַמִּי֙ מִיֶּדְכֶ֔ן
kjv_line: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand,

hebrew_line: לָכֵ֣ן דַּבֵּר־א֠וֹתָם וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אִ֣ישׁ אִ֣ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲלֶ֨ה אֶת־גִּלּוּלָ֜יו אֶל־לִבּ֗וֹ
kjv_line: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart,

hebrew_line: וְיִנָּזֵ֣ר מֵֽאַחֲרַ֗י וְיַ֤עַל גִּלּוּלָיו֙ אֶל־לִבּ֔וֹ
kjv_line: which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart,

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתִּ֨י פָנַ֜י בָּאִ֣ישׁ הַה֗וּא וַהֲשִֽׂמֹתִ֙יהוּ֙ לְא֣וֹת
kjv_line: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign

hebrew_line: וְנָטִ֤יתִי אֶת־יָדִי֙ עָלָ֔יו וְהִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔יו מִתּ֖וֹךְ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
