hebrew_line: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי֙ אֶת־פַּתְר֔וֹס וְנָתַ֥תִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּצֹ֑עַן
kjv_line: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan,

hebrew_line: בַּח֥וּרֵי אָ֛וֶן וּפִי־בֶ֖סֶת בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ וְהֵ֖נָּה
kjv_line: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword:

hebrew_line: וְהוּרַדְתָּ֨ אֶת־עֲצֵי־עֵ֜דֶן אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֗ית בְּת֨וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֤ים תִּשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חֶ֔רֶב
kjv_line: yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword.

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־בְּשָׂרְךָ֖ עַל־הֶֽהָרִ֑ים וּמִלֵּאתִ֥י הַגֵּאָי֖וֹת רָמוּתֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.

hebrew_line: וְכִסֵּיתִ֤י בְכַבּֽוֹתְךָ֙ שָׁמַ֔יִם וְהִקְדַּרְתִּ֖י אֶת־כֹּֽכְבֵיהֶ֑ם שֶׁ֚מֶשׁ בֶּעָנָ֣ן אֲכַסֶּ֔נּוּ
kjv_line: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud,

hebrew_line: בְּת֥וֹךְ חַלְלֵי־חֶ֖רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ חֶ֣רֶב נִתָּ֔נָה מָשְׁכ֥וּ אוֹתָ֖הּ וְכָל־הֲמוֹנֶֽיהָ׃
kjv_line: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.

hebrew_line: וְאַתָּ֗ה בְּת֧וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֛ים תִּשָּׁבַ֥ר וְתִשְׁכַּ֖ב אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חָֽרֶב׃
kjv_line: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.

hebrew_line: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶל־בְּנֵֽי־עַמְּךָ֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֶ֕רֶץ כִּֽי־אָבִ֥יא עָלֶ֖יהָ חָ֑רֶב
kjv_line: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land,

hebrew_line: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֤ מִפִּי֙ דָּבָ֔ר וְהִזְהַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
kjv_line: therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.

hebrew_line: וְשָׁב֙ מֵֽחַטָּאת֔וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
kjv_line: if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

hebrew_line: חֲבֹ֨ל יָשִׁ֤יב רָשָׁע֙ גְּזֵלָ֣ה יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם
kjv_line: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed,

hebrew_line: וּבְשׁ֤וּב רָשָׁע֙ מֵֽרִשְׁעָת֔וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם ה֥וּא יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
kjv_line: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

hebrew_line: וְיָב֣וֹאוּ אֵ֠לֶיךָ כִּמְבוֹא־עָ֞ם וְיֵשְׁב֤וּ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ עַמִּ֔י וְשָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ וְאוֹתָ֖ם
kjv_line: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words,

hebrew_line: אֶת־הַחֵ֤לֶב תֹּאכֵ֙לוּ֙ וְאֶת־הַצֶּ֣מֶר תִּלְבָּ֔שׁוּ
kjv_line: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool,

hebrew_line: וְדָרַשְׁתִּ֥י אֶת־צֹאנִ֖י וּבִקַּרְתִּֽים׃
kjv_line: Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

hebrew_line: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֣ים מִן־הָעַמִּ֗ים וְקִבַּצְתִּים֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת וַהֲבִיאֹתִ֖ים אֶל־אַדְמָתָ֑ם
kjv_line: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land,

hebrew_line: אֲנִ֨י אֶרְעֶ֤ה צֹאנִי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אַרְבִּיצֵ֔ם
kjv_line: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down,

hebrew_line: אֶת־הָאֹבֶ֤דֶת אֲבַקֵּשׁ֙ וְאֶת־הַנִּדַּ֣חַת אָשִׁ֔יב
kjv_line: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away,

hebrew_line: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֨י עֲלֵיהֶ֜ם רֹעֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ וְרָעָ֣ה אֶתְהֶ֔ן אֵ֖ת עַבְדִּ֣י דָוִ֑יד
kjv_line: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David;

hebrew_line: וְכָרַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית שָׁל֔וֹם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י חַיָּֽה־רָעָ֖ה
kjv_line: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease

hebrew_line: וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ שְׁמָמָ֥ה וּמְשַׁמָּֽה׃
kjv_line: I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.

hebrew_line: לָכֵ֕ן הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֡ לֶהָרִ֣ים
kjv_line: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains,

hebrew_line: הִנְנִ֣י אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְנֶעֱבַדְתֶּ֖ם
kjv_line: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled

hebrew_line: וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֜ם כְּקַדְמֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהֵטִֽבֹתִי֙ מֵרִאשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם
kjv_line: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings:

hebrew_line: וְהוֹלַכְתִּי֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם אָדָ֜ם אֶת־עַמִּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִֽירֵשׁ֔וּךָ
kjv_line: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess

hebrew_line: וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְקִבַּצְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם
kjv_line: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather

hebrew_line: וַהֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י אֶת־לֵ֤ב הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ מִבְּשַׂרְכֶ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר׃
kjv_line: you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

hebrew_line: בְּיוֹם֙ טַהֲרִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל עֲוֹנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהֽוֹשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים וְנִבְנ֖וּ הֶחֳרָבֽוֹת׃
kjv_line: In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתִּי֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם גִּדִ֜ים וְֽהַעֲלֵתִ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם בָּשָׂ֗ר וְקָרַמְתִּ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ ע֔וֹר
kjv_line: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin,

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתִּ֥י בָכֶ֛ם ר֖וּחַ וִחְיִיתֶ֑ם
kjv_line: and put breath in you, and ye shall live;

hebrew_line: וּפְחִ֛י בַּהֲרוּגִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְיִֽחְיֽוּ׃
kjv_line: and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתִּ֨י רוּחִ֤י בָכֶם֙ וִחְיִיתֶ֔ם
kjv_line: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live,

hebrew_line: וְקָרַ֨ב אֹתָ֜ם אֶחָ֧ד אֶל־אֶחָ֛ד לְךָ֖ לְעֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֑ד וְהָי֥וּ לַאֲחָדִ֖ים בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
kjv_line: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.

hebrew_line: וְנָתַתִּי֩ אוֹתָ֨ם עָלָ֜יו אֶת־עֵ֣ץ יְהוּדָ֗ה וַֽעֲשִׂיתִם֙ לְעֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֔ד וְהָי֥וּ אֶחָ֖ד בְּיָדִֽי׃
kjv_line: and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.

hebrew_line: וְקִבַּצְתִּ֤י אֹתָם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם אֶל־אַדְמָתָֽם׃
kjv_line: and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

hebrew_line: וְטִהַרְתִּ֤י אוֹתָם֙ וְהָיוּ־לִ֣י לְעָ֔ם וַאֲנִ֕י
kjv_line: and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people,

hebrew_line: וּנְתַתִּים֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם
kjv_line: with them: and I will place them, and multiply

hebrew_line: וְשׁ֣וֹבַבְתִּ֔יךָ וְנָתַתִּ֥י חַחִ֖ים בִּלְחָיֶ֑יךָ
kjv_line: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws,

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יַעֲל֤וּ דְבָרִים֙ עַל־לְבָבֶ֔ךָ
kjv_line: It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into thy mind,

hebrew_line: וְנֶהֶרְס֣וּ הֶהָרִ֗ים וְנָֽפְלוּ֙ הַמַּדְרֵג֔וֹת
kjv_line: and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall,

hebrew_line: וְשֹׁבַבְתִּ֙יךָ֙ וְשִׁשֵּׁאתִ֔יךָ
kjv_line: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part

hebrew_line: וְשָׁלְל֣וּ אֶת־שֹׁלְלֵיהֶ֗ם וּבָֽזְזוּ֙ אֶת־בֹּ֣זְזֵיהֶ֔ם
kjv_line: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed

hebrew_line: וְעָבְר֤וּ הָעֹֽבְרִים֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרָאָה֙ עֶ֣צֶם אָדָ֔ם
kjv_line: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man's bone,

hebrew_line: בְּשַׂ֤ר גִּבּוֹרִים֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ וְדַם־נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּשְׁתּ֑וּ
kjv_line: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth,

hebrew_line: וּבְאָזְנֶ֨יךָ שְּׁמָ֜ע וְשִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֗ לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתָ֔ךְ
kjv_line: and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew

hebrew_line: וּבָ֣א לִפְנִ֔ימָה וַיָּ֥מָד אֵֽיל־הַפֶּ֖תַח שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת
kjv_line: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits;

hebrew_line: עַתָּ֞ה יְרַחֲק֧וּ אֶת־זְנוּתָ֛ם וּפִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֥י בְתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃
kjv_line: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

hebrew_line: וְיִכָּלְמ֖וּ מֵעֲוֹנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וּמָדְד֖וּ אֶת־תָּכְנִֽית׃
kjv_line: that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.

hebrew_line: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִדָּמ֗וֹ וְנָ֨תַתָּ֜ה עַל־אַרְבַּ֤ע קַרְנֹתָיו֙
kjv_line: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns

hebrew_line: וְטִֽהֲר֖וּ אֹת֑וֹ וּמִלְא֖וּ יָדָֽיו׃
kjv_line: and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

hebrew_line: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֜י וָהָ֗לְאָה יַעֲשׂ֨וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ אֶת־עוֹלֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְאֶת־שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֔ם וְרָצִ֣אתִי אֶתְכֶ֔ם
kjv_line: it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept

hebrew_line: הַזֶּה֩ סָג֨וּר יִהְיֶ֜ה לֹ֣א יִפָּתֵ֗חַ וְאִישׁ֙ לֹא־יָ֣בֹא ב֔וֹ
kjv_line: shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter

hebrew_line: וְעַל־רִ֗יב הֵ֚מָּה יַעַמְד֣וּ לְמִשְׁפָּ֔ט בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י יִשְׁפְּט֑וּהוּ
kjv_line: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments:

hebrew_line: וּמִן־הַמִּדָּ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ תָּמ֔וֹד אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּבֽוֹ־יִהְיֶ֥ה הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָדָשִֽׁים׃
kjv_line: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.

hebrew_line: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֣ם הַחַטָּ֗את וְנָתַן֙ אֶל־מְזוּזַ֣ת הַבַּ֔יִת
kjv_line: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house,

hebrew_line: וּבָ֣א הַנָּשִׂ֡יא דֶּרֶךְ֩ אוּלָ֨ם הַשַּׁ֜עַר מִח֗וּץ וְעָמַד֙ עַל־מְזוּזַ֣ת הַשַּׁ֔עַר
kjv_line: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate,

hebrew_line: וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוָ֛ה עַל־מִפְתַּ֥ן הַשַּׁ֖עַר וְיָצָ֑א
kjv_line: and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth;

hebrew_line: וְלֹֽא־יִתֹּ֣ם פִּרְי֗וֹ לָֽחֳדָשָׁיו֙ יְבַכֵּ֔ר
kjv_line: neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months,

hebrew_line: יָמִ֣ים עֲשָׂרָ֑ה וְיִתְּנוּ־לָ֜נוּ מִן־הַזֵּרֹעִ֛ים וְנֹאכְלָ֖ה
kjv_line: I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat,

hebrew_line: תְּקַבְּל֖וּן מִן־קֳדָמָ֑י לָהֵ֕ן חֶלְמָ֥א וּפִשְׁרֵ֖הּ הַחֲוֹֽנִי׃
kjv_line: thereof, ye shall receive of me therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.

hebrew_line: תְּחֹת֜וֹהִי תַּטְלֵ֣ל׀ חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָ֗א וּבְעַנְפ֙וֹהִי֙ יְדוּרָן֙ צִפֲּרֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א
kjv_line: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs

hebrew_line: קָרֵ֨א בְחַ֜יִל וְכֵ֣ן אָמַ֗ר גֹּ֤דּוּ אִֽילָנָא֙ וְקַצִּ֣צוּ עַנְפ֔וֹהִי
kjv_line: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches,

hebrew_line: וְדִ֣י חֲזָ֣ה מַלְכָּ֡א עִ֣יר וְקַדִּ֣ישׁ נָחִ֣ת׀ מִן־שְׁמַיָּ֡א וְאָמַר֩ גֹּ֨דּוּ אִֽילָנָ֜א וְחַבְּל֗וּהִי בְּרַ֨ם עִקַּ֤ר שָׁרְשׁ֙וֹהִי֙ בְּאַרְעָ֣א שְׁבֻ֔קוּ
kjv_line: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth,

hebrew_line: וְעִם־חֵיוַ֣ת בָּרָא֩ לֶהֱוֵ֨ה מְדֹרָ֜ךְ וְעִשְׂבָּ֥א כְתוֹרִ֣ין׀ לָ֣ךְ יְטַֽעֲמ֗וּן
kjv_line: and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen,

hebrew_line: עֲנָ֨ת מַלְכְּתָ֜א וַאֲמֶ֗רֶת מַלְכָּא֙ לְעָלְמִ֣ין חֱיִ֔י אַֽל־יְבַהֲלוּךְ֙ רַעְיוֹנָ֔ךְ
kjv_line: and the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not thy thoughts trouble

hebrew_line: מַתְּנָתָךְ֙ לָ֣ךְ לֶֽהֶוְיָ֔ן וּנְבָ֥זְבְּיָתָ֖ךְ לְאָחֳרָ֣ן הַ֑ב
kjv_line: Let thy gifts be to thyself, and give thy rewards to another;

hebrew_line: כְּעַ֣ן מַלְכָּ֔א תְּקִ֥ים אֱסָרָ֖א וְתִרְשֻׁ֣ם כְּתָבָ֑א
kjv_line: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing,

hebrew_line: וְאָחֳרָ֞ן יְק֣וּם אַחֲרֵיה֗וֹן וְה֤וּא יִשְׁנֵא֙ מִן־קַדְמָיֵ֔א
kjv_line: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first,

hebrew_line: אֲנָ֨ה דָֽנִיֵּ֜אל שַׂגִּ֣יא׀ רַעְיוֹנַ֣י יְבַהֲלֻנַּ֗נִי וְזִיוַי֙ יִשְׁתַּנּ֣וֹן עֲלַ֔י וּמִלְּתָ֖א
kjv_line: As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: the matter

hebrew_line: פְּקַ֣ח עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖
kjv_line: open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name:

hebrew_line: וּמָשַׁל֙ מִמְשָׁ֣ל רַ֔ב וְעָשָׂ֖ה כִּרְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

hebrew_line: וּבָנָ֣יו יִתְגָּר֗וּ וְאָסְפוּ֙ הֲמוֹן֙ חֲיָלִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים
kjv_line: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces:

hebrew_line: וְיִתְמַרְמַר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֔גֶב וְיָצָ֕א
kjv_line: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth

hebrew_line: וְהֶעֱמִיד֙ הָמ֣וֹן רָ֔ב וְנִתַּ֥ן הֶהָמ֖וֹן בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
kjv_line: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

hebrew_line: וְיִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ סֽוֹלֲלָ֔ה וְלָכַ֖ד עִ֣יר מִבְצָר֑וֹת וּזְרֹע֤וֹת הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔דוּ
kjv_line: and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand,

hebrew_line: וְיָשֵׂ֧ם פָּנָ֛יו לְאִיִּ֖ים וְלָכַ֣ד רַבִּ֑ים
kjv_line: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many:

hebrew_line: וְיָשֵׁ֣ב פָּנָ֔יו לְמָעוּזֵּ֖י אַרְצ֑וֹ וְנִכְשַׁ֥ל וְנָפַ֖ל
kjv_line: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall,

hebrew_line: וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד כִּֽי־יַחְשְׁב֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מַחֲשָׁבֽוֹת׃
kjv_line: but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.

hebrew_line: וְאֹכְלֵ֧י פַת־בָּג֛וֹ יִשְׁבְּר֖וּהוּ וְחֵיל֣וֹ יִשְׁט֑וֹף
kjv_line: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow:

hebrew_line: וּבָ֨אוּ ב֜וֹ צִיִּ֤ים כִּתִּים֙ וְנִכְאָ֔ה
kjv_line: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved,

hebrew_line: וְחִלְּל֞וּ הַמִּקְדָּ֤שׁ הַמָּעוֹז֙ וְהֵסִ֣ירוּ הַתָּמִ֔יד
kjv_line: on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily

hebrew_line: יַחֲזִ֥קוּ וְעָשֽׂוּ׃
kjv_line: shall be strong, and do exploits.

hebrew_line: וּמַשְׂכִּ֣ילֵי עָ֔ם יָבִ֖ינוּ לָֽרַבִּ֑ים וְנִכְשְׁל֞וּ בְּחֶ֧רֶב
kjv_line: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword,

hebrew_line: וְעָשָׂ֨ה כִרְצוֹנ֜וֹ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְיִתְרוֹמֵ֤ם וְיִתְגַּדֵּל֙ עַל־כָּל־אֵ֔ל
kjv_line: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god,

hebrew_line: וְעַֽל־כָּל־אֱל֖וֹהַּ לֹ֣א יָבִ֑ין כִּ֥י עַל־כֹּ֖ל יִתְגַּדָּֽל׃
kjv_line: nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.

hebrew_line: וְאַתָּ֣ה דָֽנִיֵּ֗אל סְתֹ֧ם הַדְּבָרִ֛ים וַחֲתֹ֥ם הַסֵּ֖פֶר
kjv_line: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book,

hebrew_line: כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אוֹסִ֜יף ע֗וֹד אֲרַחֵם֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
kjv_line: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel;

hebrew_line: וְשָׂמ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם רֹ֥אשׁ אֶחָ֖ד וְעָל֣וּ מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י גָד֖וֹל
kjv_line: and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great

hebrew_line: וְרִדְּפָ֤ה אֶת־מְאַהֲבֶ֙יהָ֙ וְלֹֽא־תַשִּׂ֣יג אֹתָ֔ם וּבִקְשָׁ֖תַם
kjv_line: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek

hebrew_line: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣ים לְיַ֔עַר וַאֲכָלָ֖תַם חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
kjv_line: me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

hebrew_line: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃
kjv_line: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אֶֽעֱנֶה֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD,

hebrew_line: וּזְרַעְתִּ֤יהָ לִּי֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרִֽחַמְתִּ֖י אֶת־לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה
kjv_line: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy;

hebrew_line: עַל־כֵּ֣ן׀ תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הָאָ֗רֶץ וְאֻמְלַל֙ כָּל־יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֔הּ
kjv_line: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish,

hebrew_line: לֹֽא־אֶפְק֨וֹד עַל־בְּנוֹתֵיכֶ֜ם כִּ֣י תִזְנֶ֗ינָה
kjv_line: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom,

hebrew_line: וְעִם־הַקְּדֵשׁ֖וֹת יְזַבֵּ֑חוּ וְעָ֥ם לֹֽא־יָבִ֖ין
kjv_line: and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand

hebrew_line: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹ֨את הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים וְהַקְשִׁ֣יבוּ׀ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּבֵ֤ית הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַאֲזִ֔ינוּ
kjv_line: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king;

hebrew_line: תִּקְע֤וּ שׁוֹפָר֙ בַּגִּבְעָ֔ה חֲצֹצְרָ֖ה בָּרָמָ֑ה הָרִ֙יעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אָ֔וֶן
kjv_line: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven,

hebrew_line: יְחַיֵּ֖נוּ מִיֹּמָ֑יִם בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקִמֵ֖נוּ
kjv_line: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up,

hebrew_line: עַתָּ֞ה יִזְכֹּ֤ר עֲוֹנָם֙ וְיִפְקֹ֣ד חַטֹּאותָ֔ם הֵ֖מָּה
kjv_line: them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins:

hebrew_line: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־אֵ֣שׁ בְּעָרָ֔יו וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
kjv_line: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

hebrew_line: מֹ֣ף תְּקַבְּרֵ֑ם מַחְמַ֣ד לְכַסְפָּ֗ם קִמּוֹשׂ֙ יִֽירָשֵׁ֔ם ח֖וֹחַ בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶֽם׃
kjv_line: Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.

hebrew_line: אַרְכִּ֤יב אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ יַחֲר֣וֹשׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה יְשַׂדֶּד־ל֖וֹ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
kjv_line: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.

hebrew_line: זִרְע֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם לִצְדָקָה֙ קִצְר֣וּ לְפִי־חֶ֔סֶד נִ֥ירוּ לָכֶ֖ם נִ֑יר
kjv_line: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground:

hebrew_line: וְאַ֥ט אֵלָ֖יו אוֹכִֽיל׃
kjv_line: and I laid meat unto them.

hebrew_line: אֵ֞יךְ אֶתֶּנְךָ֣ אֶפְרַ֗יִם אֲמַגֶּנְךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
kjv_line: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel?

hebrew_line: אַחֲרֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה יֵלְכ֖וּ כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה יִשְׁאָ֑ג
kjv_line: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion:

hebrew_line: וַיִּתְחַנֶּן־ל֑וֹ בֵּֽית־אֵל֙ יִמְצָאֶ֔נּוּ
kjv_line: and made supplication unto him: he found him in Beth-el,

hebrew_line: בֵּאלֹהֶ֣יךָ תָשׁ֑וּב חֶ֤סֶד וּמִשְׁפָּט֙ שְׁמֹ֔ר
kjv_line: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment,

hebrew_line: וָאֱהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם כְּמוֹ־שָׁ֑חַל כְּנָמֵ֖ר עַל־דֶּ֥רֶךְ אָשֽׁוּר׃
kjv_line: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:

hebrew_line: וְאֶקְרַ֖ע סְג֣וֹר לִבָּ֑ם וְאֹכְלֵ֥ם שָׁם֙ כְּלָבִ֔יא
kjv_line: of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion:

hebrew_line: מִיַּ֤ד שְׁאוֹל֙ אֶפְדֵּ֔ם מִמָּ֖וֶת אֶגְאָלֵ֑ם
kjv_line: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death:

hebrew_line: יָב֣וֹא קָדִים֩ ר֨וּחַ יְהוָ֜ה מִמִּדְבָּ֣ר עֹלֶ֗ה וְיֵב֤וֹשׁ מְקוֹרוֹ֙ וְיֶחֱרַ֣ב מַעְיָנ֔וֹ
kjv_line: an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up:

hebrew_line: אֶרְפָּא֙ מְשׁ֣וּבָתָ֔ם אֹהֲבֵ֖ם נְדָבָ֑ה
kjv_line: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely:

hebrew_line: מִ֤י חָכָם֙ וְיָ֣בֵֽן אֵ֔לֶּה נָב֖וֹן וְיֵֽדָעֵ֑ם
kjv_line: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them?

hebrew_line: תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֜ר בְּצִיּ֗וֹן וְהָרִ֙יעוּ֙ בְּהַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֔י
kjv_line: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain:

hebrew_line: כְּגִבּוֹרִ֣ים יְרֻצ֔וּן כְּאַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה יַעֲל֣וּ חוֹמָ֑ה
kjv_line: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war;

hebrew_line: וְאִ֤ישׁ בִּדְרָכָיו֙ יֵֽלֵכ֔וּן וְלֹ֥א יְעַבְּט֖וּן אֹרְחוֹתָֽם׃
kjv_line: and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:

hebrew_line: בָּעִ֣יר יָשֹׁ֗קּוּ בַּֽחוֹמָה֙ יְרֻצ֔וּן בַּבָּתִּ֖ים יַעֲל֑וּ
kjv_line: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses;

hebrew_line: תִּקְע֥וּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּצִיּ֑וֹן קַדְּשׁוּ־צ֖וֹם קִרְא֥וּ עֲצָרָֽה׃
kjv_line: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:

hebrew_line: אִסְפוּ־עָ֞ם קַדְּשׁ֤וּ קָהָל֙ קִבְצ֣וּ זְקֵנִ֔ים
kjv_line: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders,

hebrew_line: וְֽאֶת־הַצְּפוֹנִ֞י אַרְחִ֣יק מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִדַּחְתִּיו֮ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֣ה וּשְׁמָמָה֒
kjv_line: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate,

hebrew_line: אַל־תִּֽירְאִ֖י אֲדָמָ֑ה גִּ֣ילִי וּשְׂמָ֔חִי
kjv_line: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice:

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁפּ֤וֹךְ אֶת־רוּחִי֙ עַל־כָּל־בָּשָׂ֔ר
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh;

hebrew_line: וַיהוָ֞ה מִצִּיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֗ג וּמִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֔וֹ
kjv_line: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem;

hebrew_line: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יִטְּפ֧וּ הֶהָרִ֣ים עָסִ֗יס וְהַגְּבָעוֹת֙ תֵּלַ֣כְנָה חָלָ֔ב
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk,

hebrew_line: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּבֵ֣ית חֲזָאֵ֑ל וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בֶּן־הֲדָֽד׃
kjv_line: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.

hebrew_line: וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מִבִּקְעַת־אָ֔וֶן וְתוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מִבֵּ֣ית עֶ֑דֶן
kjv_line: and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden:

hebrew_line: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת עַזָּ֑ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
kjv_line: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:

hebrew_line: וַהֲשִׁיב֨וֹתִי יָדִ֜י עַל־עֶקְר֗וֹן וְאָֽבְדוּ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים
kjv_line: and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish,

hebrew_line: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּח֣וֹמַת צֹ֑ר וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
kjv_line: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.

hebrew_line: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־אֵ֣שׁ בְּמוֹאָ֔ב וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֣וֹת הַקְּרִיּ֑וֹת
kjv_line: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth:

hebrew_line: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
kjv_line: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

hebrew_line: וְעַל־בְּגָדִ֤ים חֲבֻלִים֙ יַטּ֔וּ אֵ֖צֶל כָּל־מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וְיֵ֤ין עֲנוּשִׁים֙ יִשְׁתּ֔וּ
kjv_line: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned

hebrew_line: וְעָ֖ם לֹ֣א יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ אִם־תִּהְיֶ֤ה רָעָה֙ בְּעִ֔יר וַיהוָ֖ה
kjv_line: and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the LORD

hebrew_line: וּפָֽקַדְתִּי֙ עַל־מִזְבְּח֣וֹת בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל וְנִגְדְּעוּ֙ קַרְנ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ
kjv_line: upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth-el: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off,

hebrew_line: וְאָבְד֞וּ בָּתֵּ֣י הַשֵּׁ֗ן וְסָפ֛וּ בָּתִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃
kjv_line: and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the LORD.

hebrew_line: בֹּ֤אוּ בֵֽית־אֵל֙ וּפִשְׁע֔וּ הַגִּלְגָּ֖ל הַרְבּ֣וּ
kjv_line: Come to Beth-el, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply

hebrew_line: שִׂנְאוּ־רָע֙ וְאֶ֣הֱבוּ ט֔וֹב וְהַצִּ֥יגוּ בַשַּׁ֖עַר
kjv_line: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish in the gate:

hebrew_line: וּבָ֣א הַבַּ֔יִת וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־הַקִּ֔יר
kjv_line: him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall,

hebrew_line: עִבְר֤וּ כַֽלְנֵה֙ וּרְא֔וּ וּלְכ֥וּ מִשָּׁ֖ם חֲמַ֣ת רַבָּ֑ה וּרְד֣וּ גַת־פְּלִשְׁתּ֗ים הֲטוֹבִים֙ מִן־הַמַּמְלָכ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה אִם־רַ֥ב גְּבוּלָ֖ם מִגְּבֻלְכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?

hebrew_line: הַיְרֻצ֤וּן בַּסֶּ֙לַע֙ סוּסִ֔ים אִֽם־יַחֲר֖וֹשׁ בַּבְּקָרִ֑ים
kjv_line: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen?

hebrew_line: לֵאמֹ֗ר מָתַ֞י יַעֲבֹ֤ר הַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ וְנַשְׁבִּ֣ירָה שֶּׁ֔בֶר
kjv_line: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn?

hebrew_line: הַ֤עַל זֹאת֙ לֹֽא־תִרְגַּ֣ז הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאָבַ֖ל כָּל־יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֑הּ
kjv_line: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein?

hebrew_line: בַּחֶ֣רֶב אֶהֱרֹ֑ג לֹֽא־יָנ֤וּס לָהֶם֙ נָ֔ס
kjv_line: all of them; and I will slay of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away,

hebrew_line: וְגָדַרְתִּ֣י אֶת־פִּרְצֵיהֶ֗ן וַהֲרִֽסֹתָיו֙ אָקִ֔ים וּבְנִיתִ֖יהָ כִּימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
kjv_line: and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

hebrew_line: וּבָנ֞וּ עָרִ֤ים נְשַׁמּוֹת֙ וְיָשָׁ֔בוּ
kjv_line: and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit

hebrew_line: וְדָלְק֥וּ בָהֶ֖ם וַאֲכָל֑וּם
kjv_line: and they shall kindle in them, and devour

hebrew_line: וְשָׁ֛ב מֵחֲר֥וֹן אַפּ֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א נֹאבֵֽד׃
kjv_line: and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?

hebrew_line: עַל־זֹאת֙ אֶסְפְּדָ֣ה וְאֵילִ֔ילָה אֵילְכָ֥ה שׁוֹלָ֖ל
kjv_line: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped

hebrew_line: קָרְחִ֣י וָגֹ֔זִּי עַל־בְּנֵ֖י תַּעֲנוּגָ֑יִךְ הַרְחִ֤בִי קָרְחָתֵךְ֙ כַּנֶּ֔שֶׁר
kjv_line: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle;

hebrew_line: וְחָמְד֤וּ שָׂדוֹת֙ וְגָזָ֔לוּ
kjv_line: And they covet fields, and take them by violence;

hebrew_line: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יִשָּׂ֧א עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם מָשָׁ֗ל וְנָהָ֨ה נְהִ֤י נִֽהְיָה֙ אָמַר֙ שָׁד֣וֹד נְשַׁדֻּ֔נוּ חֵ֥לֶק עַמִּ֖י יָמִ֑יר
kjv_line: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people:

hebrew_line: אָסֹ֨ף אֶאֱסֹ֜ף יַעֲקֹ֣ב כֻּלָּ֗ךְ קַבֵּ֤ץ אֲקַבֵּץ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
kjv_line: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel;

hebrew_line: וּבֹ֣שׁוּ הַחֹזִ֗ים וְחָֽפְרוּ֙ הַקֹּ֣סְמִ֔ים
kjv_line: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded:

hebrew_line: וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֗ים וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ׀ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־הַר־יְהוָ֗ה
kjv_line: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD,

hebrew_line: וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹֽרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
kjv_line: and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

hebrew_line: וּבָ֤את עַד־בָּבֶל֙ שָׁ֣ם תִּנָּצֵ֔לִי
kjv_line: and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered;

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֥ה זֶ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם אַשּׁ֣וּר׀ כִּֽי־יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֗נוּ
kjv_line: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land:

hebrew_line: וְהִצִּיל֙ מֵֽאַשּׁ֔וּר כִּֽי־יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֔נוּ
kjv_line: thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land,

hebrew_line: וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י סוּסֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖י מַרְכְּבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:

hebrew_line: אִכַּ֖ף לֵאלֹהֵ֣י מָר֑וֹם הַאֲקַדְּמֶ֣נּוּ בְעוֹל֔וֹת בַּעֲגָלִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃
kjv_line: and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?

hebrew_line: וְתוּשִׁיָּ֖ה יִרְאֶ֣ה שְׁמֶ֑ךָ שִׁמְע֥וּ מַטֶּ֖ה וּמִ֥י יְעָדָֽהּ׃
kjv_line: and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.

hebrew_line: אַתָּ֤ה תֹאכַל֙ וְלֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּ֔ע
kjv_line: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied;

hebrew_line: אַתָּ֤ה תִדְרֹֽךְ־זַ֙יִת֙ וְלֹא־תָס֣וּךְ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁתֶּה־יָּֽיִן׃
kjv_line: thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.

hebrew_line: וַאֲנִי֙ בַּיהוָ֣ה אֲצַפֶּ֔ה אוֹחִ֖ילָה
kjv_line: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait

hebrew_line: אַֽל־תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י אֹיַ֙בְתִּי֙ לִ֔י כִּ֥י נָפַ֖לְתִּי קָ֑מְתִּי כִּֽי־אֵשֵׁ֣ב בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ
kjv_line: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness,

hebrew_line: וְתֵרֶ֤א אֹיַ֙בְתִּי֙ וּתְכַסֶּ֣הָ בוּשָׁ֔ה
kjv_line: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover

hebrew_line: יִרְא֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ וְיֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מִכֹּ֖ל גְּבֽוּרָתָ֑ם
kjv_line: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might:

hebrew_line: יִכְבֹּ֖שׁ עֲוֹֽנֹתֵ֑ינוּ וְתַשְׁלִ֛יךְ בִּמְצֻל֥וֹת יָ֖ם כָּל־חַטֹּאותָֽם׃
kjv_line: upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

hebrew_line: וּבְשֶׁ֣טֶף עֹבֵ֔ר כָּלָ֖ה יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מְקוֹמָ֑הּ וְאֹיְבָ֖יו יְרַדֶּף־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
kjv_line: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.

hebrew_line: מִבֵּ֨ית אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אַכְרִ֨ית פֶּ֧סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֛ה אָשִׂ֥ים קִבְרֶ֖ךָ
kjv_line: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave;

hebrew_line: צַפֵּה־דֶ֙רֶךְ֙ חַזֵּ֣ק מָתְנַ֔יִם אַמֵּ֥ץ כֹּ֖חַ מְאֹֽד׃
kjv_line: watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.

hebrew_line: בַּֽחוּצוֹת֙ יִתְהוֹלְל֣וּ הָרֶ֔כֶב יִֽשְׁתַּקְשְׁק֖וּן בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת מַרְאֵיהֶן֙ כַּלַּפִּידִ֔ם
kjv_line: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches,

hebrew_line: חַזְּקִ֖י מִבְצָרָ֑יִךְ בֹּ֧אִי בַטִּ֛יט וְרִמְסִ֥י בַחֹ֖מֶר
kjv_line: fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter,

hebrew_line: תֹּאכְלֵ֖ךְ כַּיָּ֑לֶק הִתְכַּבֵּ֣ד כַּיֶּ֔לֶק הִֽתְכַּבְּדִ֖י כָּאַרְבֶּֽה׃
kjv_line: it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.

hebrew_line: לָ֣מָּה תַרְאֵ֤נִי אָ֙וֶן֙ וְעָמָ֣ל תַּבִּ֔יט
kjv_line: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance?

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֧י רִ֦יב וּמָד֖וֹן יִשָּֽׂא׃
kjv_line: are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.

hebrew_line: עַל־כֵּן֙ יְזַבֵּ֣חַ לְחֶרְמ֔וֹ וִֽיקַטֵּ֖ר לְמִכְמַרְתּ֑וֹ
kjv_line: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag;

hebrew_line: וְלֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב אִם־יִתְמַהְמָהּ֙ חַכֵּה־ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־בֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א
kjv_line: and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come,

hebrew_line: לְפָנָ֖יו יֵ֣לֶךְ דָּ֑בֶר וְיֵצֵ֥א רֶ֖שֶׁף לְרַגְלָֽיו׃
kjv_line: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.

hebrew_line: בְּזַ֖עַם תִּצְעַד־אָ֑רֶץ בְּאַ֖ף תָּד֥וּשׁ גּוֹיִֽם׃
kjv_line: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.

hebrew_line: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י עַל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַקֹּֽפְאִים֙ עַל־שִׁמְרֵיהֶ֔ם הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם לֹֽא־יֵיטִ֥יב יְהוָ֖ה
kjv_line: and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good,

hebrew_line: וּבָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְלֹ֣א יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ
kjv_line: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit

hebrew_line: וַהֲצֵרֹ֣תִי לָאָדָ֗ם וְהָֽלְכוּ֙ כַּֽעִוְרִ֔ים כִּ֥י לַֽיהוָ֖ה
kjv_line: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, against the LORD:

hebrew_line: וּבְאֵשׁ֙ קִנְאָת֔וֹ תֵּאָכֵ֖ל כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־כָלָ֤ה אַךְ־נִבְהָלָה֙ יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֥ת כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
kjv_line: but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.

hebrew_line: וְהָ֣יָה חֶ֗בֶל לִשְׁאֵרִ֛ית בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יִרְע֑וּן
kjv_line: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed

hebrew_line: אָמַ֜רְתִּי אַךְ־תִּירְאִ֤י אוֹתִי֙ תִּקְחִ֣י מוּסָ֔ר
kjv_line: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction;

hebrew_line: יָשִׂ֨ישׂ עָלַ֜יִךְ בְּשִׂמְחָ֗ה יַחֲרִישׁ֙ בְּאַ֣הֲבָת֔וֹ
kjv_line: he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love,

hebrew_line: וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶת־הַצֹּלֵעָ֗ה וְהַנִּדָּחָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֔ץ
kjv_line: thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out;

hebrew_line: עֲל֥וּ הָהָ֛ר וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם עֵ֖ץ וּבְנ֣וּ הַבָּ֑יִת וְאֶרְצֶה־בּ֥וֹ וְאֶכָּבְדָ֖ה
kjv_line: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,

hebrew_line: וְהָֽפַכְתִּי֙ כִּסֵּ֣א מַמְלָכ֔וֹת וְהִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔י חֹ֖זֶק מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם
kjv_line: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen;

hebrew_line: וְנִחַ֨ם יְהוָ֥ה עוֹד֙ אֶת־צִיּ֔וֹן וּבָחַ֥ר ע֖וֹד בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
kjv_line: and the LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

hebrew_line: וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֣י בְתוֹכֵ֔ךְ
kjv_line: and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst

hebrew_line: וְנָחַ֨ל יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־יְהוּדָה֙ חֶלְק֔וֹ עַ֖ל אַדְמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּבָחַ֥ר ע֖וֹד בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
kjv_line: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

hebrew_line: וְ֠הוּא יִבְנֶ֞ה אֶת־הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ וְהֽוּא־יִשָּׂ֣א ה֔וֹד
kjv_line: Even he shall build the temple of the LORD; and he shall bear the glory,

hebrew_line: וּרְחוֹקִ֣ים׀ יָבֹ֗אוּ וּבָנוּ֙ בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה
kjv_line: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD,

hebrew_line: וִהְיִיתֶ֖ם בְּרָכָ֑ה אַל־תִּירָ֖אוּ תֶּחֱזַ֥קְנָה יְדֵיכֶֽם׃
kjv_line: you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.

hebrew_line: תֵּרֶ֨א אַשְׁקְל֜וֹן וְתִירָ֗א וְעַזָּה֙ וְתָחִ֣יל מְאֹ֔ד וְעֶקְר֖וֹן
kjv_line: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron;

hebrew_line: גִּילִ֨י מְאֹ֜ד בַּת־צִיּ֗וֹן הָרִ֙יעִי֙ בַּ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם
kjv_line: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem:

hebrew_line: וַֽחֲלֹמוֹת֙ הַשָּׁ֣וא יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ הֶ֖בֶל יְנַֽחֵמ֑וּן
kjv_line: and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain:

hebrew_line: וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ יִרְא֣וּ וְשָׂמֵ֔חוּ יָגֵ֥ל לִבָּ֖ם בַּיהוָֽה׃
kjv_line: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.

hebrew_line: אֶשְׁרְקָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם וַאֲקַבְּצֵ֖ם כִּ֣י פְדִיתִ֑ים
kjv_line: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed

hebrew_line: פְּתַ֥ח לְבָנ֖וֹן דְּלָתֶ֑יךָ וְתֹאכַ֥ל אֵ֖שׁ בַּאֲרָזֶֽיךָ׃
kjv_line: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.

hebrew_line: אֲשֶׁ֨ר קֹנֵיהֶ֤ן יַֽהֲרְגֻן֙ וְלֹ֣א יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ וּמֹכְרֵיהֶ֣ן יֹאמַ֔ר
kjv_line: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say,

hebrew_line: וְכִתְּתוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א אַצִּ֖יל מִיָּדָֽם׃
kjv_line: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.

hebrew_line: הַמֵּתָ֣ה תָמ֗וּת וְהַנִּכְחֶ֙דֶת֙ תִּכָּחֵ֔ד
kjv_line: you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off;

hebrew_line: הַנִּצָּבָה֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכֵּ֔ל וּבְשַׂ֤ר הַבְּרִיאָה֙ יֹאכַ֔ל
kjv_line: nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat,

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה בַיּוֹם־הַ֠הוּא אָשִׂ֨ים אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶ֤בֶן מַֽעֲמָסָה֙ לְכָל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כָּל־עֹמְסֶ֖יהָ
kjv_line: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden

hebrew_line: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם׀ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אַכְרִ֞ית אֶת־שְׁמ֤וֹת הָֽעֲצַבִּים֙ מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ
kjv_line: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land,

hebrew_line: הַ֤ךְ אֶת־הָֽרֹעֶה֙ וּתְפוּצֶ֣יןָ הַצֹּ֔אן
kjv_line: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered:

hebrew_line: וְנִלְכְּדָ֣ה הָעִ֗יר וְנָשַׁ֙סּוּ֙ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים
kjv_line: and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled,

hebrew_line: וְנַסְתֶּ֣ם גֵּֽיא־הָרַ֗י כִּֽי־יַגִּ֣יעַ גֵּי־הָרִים֮ אֶל־אָצַל֒
kjv_line: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal:

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה יוֹם־אֶחָ֗ד ה֛וּא יִוָּדַ֥ע לַֽיהוָ֖ה לֹא־י֣וֹם
kjv_line: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day,

hebrew_line: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יֵצְא֤וּ מַֽיִם־חַיִּים֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם
kjv_line: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem;

hebrew_line: הַקְרִיבֵ֨הוּ נָ֜א לְפֶחָתֶ֗ךָ הֲיִרְצְךָ֙ א֚וֹ הֲיִשָּׂ֣א פָנֶ֔יךָ
kjv_line: offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person?

hebrew_line: וְעַתָּ֛ה חַלּוּ־נָ֥א פְנֵי־אֵ֖ל וִֽיחָנֵ֑נוּ
kjv_line: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious

hebrew_line: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י בָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַמְּאֵרָ֔ה וְאָרוֹתִ֖י אֶת־בִּרְכֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְגַם֙ אָרוֹתִ֔יהָ
kjv_line: I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed

hebrew_line: וְטִהַ֤ר אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־לֵוִי֙ וְזִקַּ֣ק אֹתָ֔ם כַּזָּהָ֖ב
kjv_line: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold

hebrew_line: הָבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־כָּל־הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֜ר אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הָאוֹצָ֗ר וִיהִ֥י טֶ֙רֶף֙ בְּבֵיתִ֔י
kjv_line: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house,
